title: Senior HR Business Partner, Technology (APAC)
description:
Senior HR Business Partner, Technology (APAC)

**About Millennium**  
Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

  

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact.

**Meet the Team**

Millennium’s Human Resources Department covers the full spectrum of HR disciplines. Through high-touch, impactful solutions, the team helps optimize organizational performance and fosters a working environment and culture that attracts, engages, and retains exceptional talent across the firm.

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the lead HR Business Partner for Technology teams across APAC, acting as the primary HR contact and trusted adviser to senior Technology leaders, with broader India coverage as needed
* Using people data and insights, translate business priorities into practical, commercially focused people plans that support performance, engagement, development, and retention across local and global initiatives.
* Lead People BP employee life cycle activities, including annual compensation and, talent review cycles, and employee life cycle ,
* Coach senior leaders and managers to strengthen people-management capability and drive consistent, fair performance management, including performance improvement plans.\
* Advise on employment practices, policies, and procedures across APAC, with particular depth in Indian labor law, while balancing legal compliance, commercial needs, and employee experience. This includes leading complex employee relations matters, including conduct issues, grievances, investigations, performance exits, and terminations, partnering with Employment Legal to manage risk.
* Working with People Operations, ensure HR delivery for client groups, from manager and employee queries to documentation and process execution, alongside strategic priorities.
* Broader HR team collaboration: Partner with Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, People Operations, Global Mobility, and Compensation and Benefits to deliver integrated solutions and change initiatives, while coaching the People Business Partner in India.

**What You Bring**

* 15+ years of HR experience, including at least 8 years in senior HR Business Partner roles, ideally in fast-paced, high-accountability environments; financial services experience is beneficial.
* Experience supporting sizable Technology organizations and senior leaders in a global, matrixed environment, such as a global capability center or multinational technology firm.
* Strong practical knowledge of Indian employment law and practices, with foundational familiarity with employment practices in Hong Kong and Singapore.
* A demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across geographies and reporting lines, and to independently resolve complex, sensitive, and high-risk people matters.
* A strategic, hands-on approach, with the ability to advise senior leaders on people strategy while personally executing day-to-day HR work in a lean team.
* Commercial acumen and the ability to balance employee experience, legal compliance, and business requirements when advising leaders.
* Exceptional relationship-building, communication, and influencing skills, with sound judgment, discretion, and integrity in handling confidential matters.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate people data into action and manage competing priorities in a demanding, ambiguous environment.

title: Lead Employee Success People Consultant
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Employee Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too - driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good - you’ve come to the right place.

  
  

The organisation is seeking an Employee Success Partner Consultant (ESPC) to join the ESBP team in India. The ideal candidate will understand the business and talent strategy, building strong connections with stakeholders and people managers. They will coach and support people managers, drive HR programs, and use data analytics to offer insights for talent management. Additionally, they will participate in regional and country-specific initiatives to ensure alignment with global goals. The ideal candidate will possess strong project management skills, data analytics expertise, and the ability to adapt to changing situations, fostering a culture of success.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* In partnership with ESBPs, support and lead ES Cyclical programs.
* Analyse and provide insights on all programs (i.e. compensation, merit, promotion, GIS, G4G, etc.), offering support to regional ESBP and supported organisations.
* Process input and design, including running audits to ensure program effectiveness.
* Partnering with One ES (CoEs and other ES stakeholders) to ensure success of ES Programs and garner support on India level projects/initiatives.
* Global ESPC Community Connect, aligning with the Global PC organisation and facilitating two-way best practice sharing.
* Support ESBPs in driving ES programs with data-driven insights/audits: Talent Review, Performance Management, Performance ratings, GIS, G4G, Promotions, Merit cycle, Performance management, Periodic Business Reviews, Ad hoc data requests.
* Preparing content for Business & ES QBRs (Quarterly Business Reviews).
* Establishing and maintaining strong connections with the people manager population.
* Working closely with people managers to understand their needs and provide tailored HR support.
* Proactively understands what analysis needs to be done to provide a narrative to leaders on their overall org health
* Onboards, leads, and coaches fellow ESPCs.
  

  

**Expectation and Key Behaviours:**

  

* Relevant work experience required: 5-7 years
* Efficiently manage extensive data sets, conduct analyses, derive insights, and create impactful presentations.
* Strong communication skills to effectively present viewpoints.
* Engage and collaborate with stakeholders and the workforce.
* Demonstrate curiosity and a drive to make a meaningful impact.
* Bring a positive attitude and a professional presence to the role.
* Exhibit multitasking abilities and project management expertise.
* Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter and proactive.
* Ability to develop effective relationships across all levels of the organisation.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality in all aspects of job responsibilities, including handling highly sensitive data.
* Ability to ramp up quickly, recognise Salesforce’s unique culture, and proactively help identify issues/areas of development.
* General knowledge of employment policies and practices.
* Knowledge of staffing, compensation, and talent management best practices

description:

title: Learning & Development Senior
description:
**Overview**
============

BTVK Advisory is a leading advisory firm whose specialized professionals guide clients through an ever-changing business world, helping them win now and anticipate tomorrow. BTVK Advisory, and its affiliated entities, have operations in North America, South America, Europe, Asia, and Australia. BTVK Advisory’s ultimate parent entity, Baker Tilly US, LLP, is an independent member of Baker Tilly International, a worldwide network of independent accounting and business advisory firms in 141 territories, with 43,000 professionals and a combined worldwide revenue of $5.2 billion.

*Baker Tilly is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable federal, state or local law.*

*To be added to all ET through Experienced requisitions Any unsolicited resumes submitted through our website or to Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, employee e-mail accounts are considered property of Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorized recruitment agency ("search firm") for Baker Tilly Advisory Group, LP, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by Baker Tilly's Talent Attraction team, to submit candidates for review via our applicant tracking system.*

**Job Description:**
====================

**Responsibilities:**

* Own and lead end-to-end OD programs spanning leadership development, culture, performance, talent & succession, career frameworks, managerial forums, organizational diagnostics, and surveys.
* Act as a trusted OD advisor and change partner to global business leaders and HRBPs, providing strategic guidance on people and organizational effectiveness.
* Conduct organizational diagnostics to identify capability gaps, priority development needs, and co-create scalable, locally adaptable solutions.
* Leverage secondary research and industry best practices in leadership development to enrich program design with evidence-based and innovative approaches.
* Design and tailor learning solutions aligned to identified capability gaps, competency frameworks, and overall business strategy.
* Apply instructional design and adult learning principles to create development experiences that drive measurable leadership skill growth.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure program design is contextually relevant and business-aligned.
* Define clear success metrics and evaluate program effectiveness through data analysis, participant feedback, and performance trends.
* Analyze and synthesize data insights to align development solutions and report ROI, key outcomes, and actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Partner with HRBPs and business leaders to drive organizational change, ensuring initiatives are adopted effectively across diverse, global teams.
* Cross geography collaboration for programs and projects

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required; master’s degree preferred (in a related field preferred)
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Organizational Development, Talent Management, or Talent development, preferably in a global environment.
* Proven ability to design, drive, and deliver end-to-end OD and talent initiatives in complex, fast-changing, and high-ambiguity environments.
* Strong consulting mindset with expertise in organizational diagnosis, systems thinking, facilitation, and influencing without authority.
* Demonstrated data orientation — ability to use data to diagnose issues, inform decisions, measure impact, and translate insights into compelling narratives for senior leaders.
* Experience in applying instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies to develop effective, scalable leadership programs.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder partnership skills with the ability to engage and influence across leadership levels and geographies.
* High level of ownership, self-motivation, and assertiveness with a proactive approach to problem-solving and driving outcomes.
* Practical proficiency in AI or digital tools to improve efficiency, insight generation, or scale in OD, HR, or leadership development work.
* High proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building executive-level presentations and working with complex data sets.
* Certification in psychometric or assessment tools such as DISC, MBTI, Insights Discovery, or equivalent is preferred.

title: Platform Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

**What you'll bring**

You have hands-on experience with cloud platforms, backend development, and containerized environments.

* 4 to 8 years of experience with proficiency in Python or Go for building scalable backend services and microservices.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration, and familiarity with Argo Workflows for deployment and workflow automation.
* Experience with at least one major cloud platform — AWS, GCP, or Azure — and a solid understanding of cloud architecture and scalability.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, observability tools, and performance monitoring.
* Exposure to agentic orchestration, AI governance operations, and AI-assisted development practices.
* A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.

In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates who are comfortable using AI tools — including agentic AI — in their day-to-day work, from crafting effective inputs and automating routine tasks, to evaluating AI-generated outputs for quality and driving adoption of AI practices within their teams.

**What you'll build**

You'll work on the Prompt Evaluation, Optimization and Metering Platform — building backend services that improve prompt accuracy and billing reliability.

* Design and develop scalable backend services for prompt engineering and metering, working with engineers, architects, and product managers.
* Identify and resolve data inconsistencies and billing inaccuracies to keep metering systems reliable.
* Build platform services with observability features and fault tolerance for production-grade reliability.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams in agile workflows — code reviews, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
* Develop expertise in metering and billing as a core part of your domain knowledge.
* Maintain code quality and operational readiness through automation and testing.

**Where you belong**

AI Core Team is part of SAP Business AI, building the foundational platform services that power SAP Generative AI Hub, AI Core, and AI Launchpad. The team works globally across Germany, Singapore, and India in a start-up culture that values innovation. This is where you build real platform expertise at the heart of SAP's AI products.

 **Additional Information**

About SAP  
With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives.  
As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience.  
  
We win with inclusion  
  
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.  
  
SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.  
  
For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.  
  
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.  
  
Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.  
  
AI Usage in the Recruitment Process  
  
For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.  
  
Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: Staff, AI Product Management (Global Functions)
description:
**About the Role:**

GSK’s Enterprise AI team, a highly skilled applied AI group, translates the promise of AI into measurable impact across every major group at GSK — R&D, Medical, Commercial, Supply Chain, HR, Legal, Finance, and beyond. Bionic pods — AI product managers, forward deployed engineers, full-stack engineers, data engineers, and digital workers — embed directly with scientific and business teams to build AI products that change outcomes.

We are hiring a Staff, AI Product Manager (Director level equivalent role) to own a major slice of our Global Functions portfolio and act as the strategic counterpart to the engineers and digital workers in your pod, setting the forward deployed strategy they execute against. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who can identify and shape high-value AI opportunities across the key areas of Global Functions - HR, Legal, Compliance, Procurement, or Finance, build the case to fund and deploy against them, and ensure FDEs are working on what matters most. You will not manage engineers; you will shape what they build in your domain and how we measure whether it worked.

**Why This Role Exists:**

Forward deployed teams are most powerful when paired with sharp opportunity selection. Enterprise AI has no separate strategy layer: the AI Product Manager sets the forward deployed strategy, and the pod executes it. This role closes that gap at this level by ensuring the engineers we deploy are working on the right things.

In this role you will be the person who:

* Owns a clear domain or capability area within the Enterprise AI opportunity portfolio.
* Identifies, sizes, and shapes the highest-value AI opportunities in that domain.
* Partners daily with forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads to scope and steer engagements end-to-end.
* Builds the business and executive alignment the pod needs to land and scale.

**How This Differs from Traditional Product Management:**

This is not a traditional enterprise product role managing a source system’s roadmap, releases, and backlog. As an AI Product Manager in Enterprise AI, you:

* Build new AI products from ambiguous, unsolved business problems rather than evolving an established platform.
* Work with probabilistic systems — defining evaluations, acceptable error, and human oversight instead of fixed functional requirements.
* Help lead a bionic pod, deciding which work goes to engineers and which to digital workers, and how they hand off.
* Prototype hands on and are measured on business outcomes, not features shipped or system uptime.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Opportunity Identification & Value Sizing:**

* **Hunt for high-value AI opportunities** within your assigned domain at GSK; develop a structured pipeline of opportunities ranked by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value.
* **Quantify value rigorously.** Build credible business cases that survive finance and senior business unit scrutiny — cycle time saved, decisions accelerated, revenue uplift, cost avoided, scientific productivity gained.
* **Develop deep domain pattern recognition** so you can spot AI-shaped problems in workflows the business itself hasn’t yet articulated.

**Strategic Prioritization & Portfolio Shaping:**

* **Shape the opportunity portfolio in your domain.** Maintain a living view of in-flight, queued, and de-prioritized opportunities, with the rationale for each decision, and feed it into the broader Enterprise AI portfolio.
* **Make trade-off recommendations.** When two business sponsors both want an FDE pod, defines the success metrics, run the analysis and recommend where engineers go.
* **Protect engineering focus.** Push back — with evidence — on opportunities that won’t move scalable outcomes.

  

**Engineering Partnership & Enablement**

* **Be the strategic counterpart to forward deployed, full-stack, and data engineering leads in your domain.** Translate ambiguous business problems into crisp problem statements, prototypes, success metrics, and decision frameworks engineers can build against.
* **Shape engagements end-to-end.** Define scope, success criteria, exit conditions, and scaling pathways before kick-off, then stay close as engineers execute.
* **Surface re-use and platform leverage** when a one-off solution should become a reusable capability.
* **Design the human–digital split.** Decide which tasks the pod’s digital workers own, where engineers and business users stay in the loop, and how evaluation and oversight make that safe.

**Stakeholder Alignment & Communication**

* **Operate fluently with VP-level business and scientific leaders.** Run conversations that turn fuzzy ambitions into concrete, fundable AI engagements.
* **Build sponsor coalitions** that secure data access, change-management commitment, and air cover for your engagements.
* **Communicate impact clearly** in language that connects AI work to patients, science, and enterprise outcomes.

**Measurement, Learning & Iteration**

* **Apply Enterprise AI’s value-realization framework** to every engagement in your domain and improve it with what you learn.
* **Run honest post-mortems** and feed lessons back into how your domain selects opportunities.

**Required Functional Experience:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience spanning some combination of pharma/life sciences, AI/ML product strategy, and senior product management or strategy roles in technology-led organisations.
* Demonstrated track record of identifying, scoping, prototyping, and shepherding high-value technology or AI initiatives from problem framing through funding into delivery.
* Strong working knowledge of at least one part of the pharma value chain — R&D, clinical, medical, manufacturing, commercial, or an enterprise function — including the data, decisions, and constraints inside it.
* Solid technical fluency in modern AI/ML — LLMs, agentic systems, and digital workers, ML lifecycle, data and evaluation patterns — sufficient to leverage evidence from rapid prototyping to challenge engineers, scope realistically, and avoid hype-driven choices.
* Experience operating as a senior individual contributor — leading through influence, frameworks, and quality of thinking rather than headcount.
* A product management or product-strategy heritage: discovery, opportunity sizing, roadmap shaping, prototyping, and stakeholder alignment — ideally on products whose core behaviour is AI rather than conventional software.

**Skills**

AI Platforms, AI Product Management, Generative AI, Machine Learning (ML), Production Strategy, Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Product Roadmap, Statistical Analysis, User Needs Analysis

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. description:

**Your Role**

**Process and System Responsibility**

* **Enterprise SAP Security Strategy & Architecture Ownership-**Own and lead the end-to-end security architecture across SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC landscapes. Define and govern role design standards, authorization concepts, Fiori security architecture, and cross-system integration controls. Ensure alignment with enterprise security frameworks and business process requirements.
* **Access Governance & Compliance Management**- Manage user access provisioning, modifications, and de-provisioning in line with internal policies and regulatory standards (e.g., SOX, GDPR where applicable). Perform regular access reviews, SoD analysis, and audit support to ensure ongoing compliance.
* **Process Ownership & Security Integration**- Act as the security process owner for SAP ERP environments, embedding security controls into business processes such as Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, and HR. Collaborate with functional teams to ensure secure configuration and change management practices.
* **System Monitoring & Risk Management-** Monitor SAP systems for security risks, vulnerabilities, and unauthorized activities. Conduct risk assessments, support remediation plans, and ensure timely resolution of security incidents related to SAP ERP platforms.

* **Continuous Improvement & Stakeholder Collaboration-** Drive continuous improvement of SAP security processes, including automation, Cybesecurity tool optimization, and documentation updates. Provide guidance and training to business users, IT teams, and management on SAP security best practices and governance standards.
* **Implement and enforce Zero Trust –** enable security principles within SAP ERP landscapes, ensuring strict identity verification, least-privilege access, and continuous authentication across SAP applications, users, and integrated systems. Learn the new trend, threat, and new challenges in cybersecurity area. Like Zero Trust, Double Zero

**Leadership and Collaboration**

* **Security Leadership & Governance Stewardship**- Provide strategic leadership for SAP security governance across S/4HANA and ECC platforms. Chair security review boards, define policy standards, and ensure consistent enforcement of global SAP access and control frameworks. Act as the escalation point for critical security and compliance decisions.
* **Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration-** Partner closely with Business Process Owners, IT leadership, Internal Audit, Risk & Compliance, and external auditors to align SAP security with enterprise risk strategy. Translate technical security risks into business-impact language for executive stakeholders and steering committees.
* **Transformation & Change-** Lead security workstreams during SAP implementations, upgrades, rollouts, and S/4HANA and ECC transformation programs. Drive organizational change by promoting secure-by-design principles, influencing stakeholders, and ensuring security requirements are embedded early in project lifecycles

**Impact and Performance Management**

* Is accountable for the liaison & enablement team’s results, impacting performance of related Cybersecurity Operation teams through effective demand, capacity and change management.
* Defines and tracks key KPIs (e.g., demand throughput, lead times, change success rate, capacity utilization, compliance) and drives performance improvements.
* Develops and applies policies and guidelines to enhance cybersecurity operational efficiency and process consistency in Cybersecurity Operation liaison and enablement.
* Supports resource and capacity planning and provides regular reporting on demand, capacity and change status transparent.

**Complex Problem-Solving**

* **Analyzing skills**-Analyzes complex information (e.g., audit findings, security advisories, demand/capacity data, vendor input) to support sound decision-making.
* **Sustanable and Reslience solution**- Addresses operational challenges across demand, security, testing, release and lifecycle processes with sustainable solutions.

**Strategic Impact and Accountability**

* Aligns sector needs with organizational capabilities and strategic priorities in the Cybersecurity Operation domain, acting as key advisor on feasibility, impact and trade-offs.
* Ensures that Cybersecurity Operation demand and change portfolios adhere to cost, risk and compliance frameworks and related policies/standards.

**Communication and Stakeholder Management**

* Owns daily operational performance of the Cybersecurity Operation liaison & enablement team, including demand handling and operational governance.
* Work closely with Internal and External Audit and propose the new updated cybersecurity solution to leadership team.
* Sets clear objectives, manages performance and oversees reward outcomes in line with organizational policies.
* Proactively manages stakeholder expectations across LS, IT DES, sectors and internal teams, ensuring transparent communication on priorities, risks, costs and timelines.

**Who You Are**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in SAP solution consulting, with a strong track record in solution design, and full-cycle product implementations.
* Deep understanding of SAP security and authorization concepts, including access control, authentication and data protection.
* Hands-on experience with SAP security administration and risk management (roles/profiles, provisioning, policy maintenance, risk assessment) and relevant security/compliance standards (e.g., NIS, KRITIS, GDPR, SOX).
* Proficiency with test and release management tools, ticketing systems, SAP security tools/transaction codes and ABAP for security-related custom solutions and troubleshooting
* Need the cybersecrutiy knowledge or skills related to SAP framework-OS security, DB security, Firewall concept, SAP Netowrk zone design, Network infra knowledge, Vulnerability, SAP application design security, encryption, Cloud cybersecurity architecture. Data privace and Integrity, Data protection.
* Advanced certifications in SAP Security, SAP Architecture, or Service Management technologies (e.g., SAP Certified Technology Associate)
* Knowledge on SAP DevSecOps- Deep SAP Security & Architecture Expertise, strong knowledge of SAP platforms and security architecture, including: SAP S/4HANA, SAP NetWeaver, SAP BTP, and SAP Fiori, SAP transport management and secure configuration, SAP-specific vulnerabilities and patch management. Integration of Security into DevSecOps Pipelines - Automating SAP code security scans (ABAP, UI5, integrations), Implementing security gates in pipelines, Supporting secure transport and release management, Implement continuous monitoring and compliance controls, SAP security monitoring and logging (SIEM integration), Compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, KRITS and GDPR, Managing identity governance and access risk analysis.

We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

description:

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose:**

The Principal, IAM Lifecycle Management will drive the design, engineering and delivery of enterprise identity and account lifecycle capabilities and act as the senior technical authority for the capability. This senior individual contributor role translates business, security, architecture and regulatory requirements into scalable lifecycle controls, automation and integrations across cloud, on-premises and SaaS environments. The role owns complex implementations, establishes reusable engineering practices and guides technical delivery across joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, contractor, partner and non-human identity scenarios.

**About the team:**

  

IAM Lifecycle Management owns the identity and account lifecycle end to end. The team ensures that workforce, contractor, partner and non-human identities receive appropriate access when created, joining, moving, changing status or returning, and that access is suspended or removed promptly when no longer required. It improves lifecycle automation, identity-data quality, governance controls and service reliability across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to take ownership of key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Own complex IAM lifecycle workstreams from discovery and requirements analysis through solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and operational transition.
* Act as the senior technical subject matter expert for IAM Lifecycle Management, advising product, architecture, engineering, security, risk, audit and business stakeholders.
* Mentor engineers, review solution designs and code, and establish reusable patterns, standards, documentation and engineering practices.
* Design and deliver end-to-end identity and account lifecycle capabilities, including creation, provisioning, modification, suspension, recertification and deprovisioning across on-premises, cloud and SaaS systems.
* Drive joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, contractor, partner and non-human identity lifecycle scenarios, including trigger events, approval orchestration, account states, exception handling and recovery controls.
* Drive complex application onboarding initiatives and integrations between authoritative HR and identity sources, directories, IGA platforms and target applications using connectors, APIs and event-driven services.
* Implement and improve governance controls for least privilege, segregation of duties, birthright and role-based access, account ownership, orphan-account prevention, access reviews and policy compliance.

* Ensure IAM processes, implementation evidence and control operation meet regulatory, audit and risk-management requirements, including those of highly regulated environments.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Ten or more years of relevant IAM experience, including significant hands-on engineering and technical ownership of complex identity and account lifecycle implementations.
* Strong implementation experience with an enterprise Identity Governance and Administration platform such as SailPoint, Saviynt, LINX or an equivalent product.
* Proven experience designing and delivering lifecycle solutions for joiner, mover, leaver, rehire, employee, contractor, partner and non-human identity scenarios.
* Deep understanding of provisioning and deprovisioning workflows, approval orchestration, birthright and role-based access, account-state transitions, exception handling and policy enforcement.

The ideal candidate brings deep human resources expertise combined with proven experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives, organizational redesign, change management programs, workforce modernization strategies, and AI-enabled workforce transformation across complex, matrixed environments. title: Director - IAM Lifecycle Design and Architecture
description:
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centered on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.

Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.

Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

**Job Purpose:**

The Director, IAM Lifecycle Design and Architecture will lead the design and modernisation of enterprise identity lifecycle capabilities across global hybrid environments. The role owns the target-state lifecycle architecture, reusable solution patterns, lifecycle automation, access governance, and controls for human and non-human identities.

This role will partner closely with CSO leadership team, technology executives, platform engineering, security operations, HR technology, risk, audit, and application owners to deliver scalable, secure, and compliant identity services across human, contingent workforce, machine, service, and AI agent identities.

**Key responsibilities:**

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  

* Define and govern the enterprise identity lifecycle target-state architecture, roadmap, design standards, and reusable patterns across cloud, hybrid, SaaS, on-premises, custom application, and agentic ecosystems.
* Accountable for end-to-end identity lifecycle design for employees, contingent workers, privileged users, service accounts, machine identities, non-human identities, AI agents, and digital workers, from identity creation and access fulfilment through change, review, suspension, and retirement.
* Own AI engineering delivery for IAM across agentic framework build, AI solution engineering, platform infrastructure and the data fabric pipeline
* Drive automated Joiner-Mover-Leaver processes using authoritative HR sources, identity governance tools, directory services, workflow platforms, and application integration patterns.
* Own architecture standards for access provisioning, deprovisioning, RBAC, ABAC, entitlement management, access certifications, segregation of duties, and audit evidence generation.
* Provide technical leadership for IAM platforms, HR systems, and enterprise IAM products.
* Partner with CSO teams and risk stakeholders to translate threat models, audit findings, regulatory expectations, and control gaps into funded initiatives and engineering backlogs.
* Establish governance for privileged access, secrets lifecycle, credential rotation, least privilege, service account ownership, and machine identity risk reduction.
* Build and mentor high-performing architecture and engineering teams, promoting secure-by-design practices, agile delivery, DevSecOps ways of working, and operational excellence.

**Basic Qualifications:**

  

* 20+ years of progressive IT, security, identity, or enterprise architecture experience, including leadership responsibility for IAM lifecycle design, architecture, engineering enablement, and governance.
* Deep experience designing and operating enterprise IAM, Identity lifecycle management and IGA capabilities across large-scale regulated environments.
* Hands-on architecture exposure to IAM platforms, secrets management, HR source integration, and custom IAM solutions.
* Strong architecture and implementation experience across identity standards and modern technology stacks, including SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM, LDAP, Kerberos, federation, SSO, REST APIs, GraphQL, Next.js, hybrid identity patterns, agentic implementations, Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol, and Microsoft Agent 365 (A365), with the ability to translate these technologies into secure, reusable identity lifecycle integration patterns.
* Demonstrable design experience with LLM orchestration, agentic systems, RAG patterns or API security for AI services.
* Experience creating access governance models, lifecycle automation, access certification workflows, privileged access controls, SoD controls, and audit-ready compliance evidence.
* Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders, advise CSO-level leadership, manage large global teams, and convert risk priorities into pragmatic engineering execution.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, Information Security, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Experience designing IAM solutions with SailPoint, Saviynt or a comparable platform.
* Architecture framework experience such as TOGAF or SABSA.
* Experience with cloud identity architecture across Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Familiarity with governance frameworks for agentic AI.
* Relevant certification such as CISSP, CISSP-ISSAP, SailPoint or Saviynt certification, TOGAF.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.

**Skills**

Account Lifecycle Management, Agentic AI, Authentication Systems, Automation Technology, Certificate Management, Cloud Based Services, Cloud IAM, Computer Programming, Configuration Management (CM), Database Management, Directory Services, Executive Influence, Identity Access Management (IAM), Identity Lifecycle Management, Information Technology (IT) Risk Management, Infrastructure Security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Process Architecture, Product Lifecycle, Security Controls, System Monitors, Troubleshooting

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

title: Senior Solution Engineer

title: HRBP - HR2 || 19649
description:
### **Who are we?**

  

Founded in 2014 by Khadim Batti and Vara Kumar, Whatfix is a leading global B2B SaaS provider and the largest pure-play enterprise digital adoption platform (DAP). Whatfix empowers companies to maximize the ROI of their digital investments across the application lifecycle, from ideation to training to the deployment of software. Driving user productivity, ensuring process compliance, and improving user experience of internal and customer-facing applications.

Spearheading the category with serial innovation and unmatched customer-centricity, Whatfix is the only DAP innovating beyond the category, positioning itself as a comprehensive suite for GenAI-powered digital adoption, analytics, and application simulation. Whatfix product suite consists of 3 products - DAP, Product Analytics, and Mirror. This product suite helps businesses accelerate ROI on digital investments by streamlining application deployment across its lifecycle.

Whatfix has seven offices across the US, India, UK, Germany, Singapore, and Australia and a presence across 40+ countries.

Customers: 700+ enterprise customers, including over 80 Fortune 500 companies such as Shell, Microsoft, Schneider Electric, and UPS Supply Chain Solutions.

Investors: Raised a total of ~$270 million. Most recently Series E round of $125 Million led by Warburg Pincus with participation from existing investor SoftBank Vision Fund 2. Other investors include Cisco Investments, Eight Roads Ventures (A division of Fidelity Investments), Dragoneer Investments, Peak XV Partners, and Stellaris Venture Partners.

  

* Whatfix is among the “Top 50 Indian Software Companies” as per G2 Best Software Awards.
* Recognized as a “Leader” in the digital adoption platforms (DAP) category for the past 4+ years by leading analyst firms like Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and Everest Group.
* The only vendor recognized as a Customers’ Choice in the 2024 Gartner® Voice of the Customer for Digital Adoption Platforms has once again earned the Customers’ Choice distinction in 2025. We also boast a star rating of 4.6 on G2 Crowd, 4.5 on Gartner Peer Insights, and a high CSAT of 99.8%
* Highest-Ranking DAP on 2023 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ North America for Fourth Consecutive Year
* Won the Silver for Stevie's Employer of the Year 2023 – Computer Software category and also recognized as Great Place to Work 2022-2023
* Only DAP to be among the top 35% companies worldwide in sustainability excellence with EcoVadis Bronze Medal
* On the G2 peer review platform, Whatfix has received 77 Leader badges across all market segments, including Small, Medium, and Enterprise, in 2024, among numerous other industry recognitions.

***Be one of the key members in this awesome journey of building a billion-dollar company!***

  

**What you’ll get to do?**  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Operate as an Independent Contributor and self-starter, taking end-to-end ownership of business partnering priorities for the function(s) you support. Proactively identify people-related opportunities and challenges and tactically drive them to closure.
* Develop a strong understanding of the business, its priorities, operating context, culture, and people challenges. Translate this understanding into effective people interventions, while driving the execution of strategic HR projects and identifying opportunities for future initiatives.
* Segment employees into relevant cohorts based on tenure, talent, performance, team, or other business dimensions. Conduct focused discussions to gather feedback, identify common themes, and partner with stakeholders to develop targeted action plans.
* Leverage insights from employee pulse surveys, offline feedback mechanisms, platform data, and employee conversations to understand employee sentiment and identify areas for improvement.
* Conduct exit interviews to understand reasons for attrition, explore potential retention opportunities, and systematically document insights to strengthen attrition analysis and prevention efforts.
* Utilize MIS, people analytics, data reporting, and visualization to generate meaningful insights that support business and people decisions. Maintain a high standard of data accuracy across systems and periodically review reports and employee data to ensure reliability.
* Lead and support initiatives that foster a healthy, collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing work environment within the Business Unit. Design and execute team-building and engagement interventions that strengthen team cohesion, collaboration, and morale.
* Ensure consistent implementation of HR policies, processes, and procedures in accordance with organizational guidelines and applicable legal requirements. Support employees and managers in navigating policies while ensuring appropriate governance and documentation.
* Promote ethical behavior and professional conduct across the organization. Stay informed about relevant global compliance, employment practices, and benefits requirements to support a compliant and ethical workplace.
* Partner with managers and HR stakeholders to address employee relations matters, including conflict resolution, performance concerns, disciplinary actions, grievances, and other sensitive employee situations, ensuring appropriate and timely resolution.

**Cyclic(Quarterly/Half-yearly/Annually) Responsibilities**

* Support employees and managers in understanding and navigating the Performance Management System (PMS), career development processes, and other people programs, ensuring alignment with the Whatfix Program Calendar. Partner with HRBPs and relevant COEs to implement initiatives across talent management, organizational development, employee engagement, and other people priorities.
* Own the Recognition & Rewards (R&R) process end-to-end for the supported business, from driving nominations and governance to coordinating recognition initiatives and R&R events.
* Support Compensation & Benefits (C&B) and People Operations requirements for the supported business, including compensation benchmarking and analysis, compensation review exercises, benefits-related data requirements, employee data audits, and other operational activities. Partner closely with relevant COEs and central teams to ensure timely and accurate execution.
* Contribute to central and cross-functional HR projects beyond the immediate Business Unit, as required. This may include workforce and headcount analysis, compensation or talent analytics, organizational data reviews, benchmarking exercises, HR process improvements, audits, and other ad-hoc analytical or operational requirements.
* Undertake data-driven deep dives and special projects based on evolving business or organizational needs. Work with multiple stakeholders to structure ambiguous problems, analyze relevant data, derive actionable insights, and support recommendations and execution.

**What you should have**

* 5+ years of solid HR/Business Partnering experience, preferably within a fast-paced, high-growth SaaS/technology organization.
* Strong understanding of core HR practices, with hands-on exposure to areas such as employee engagement, performance management, talent management, employee relations, people analytics, and HR operations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to work with people data, identify trends, derive insights, and translate them into actionable recommendations.
* Strong research skills with a self-directed, proactive approach and the ability to structure and navigate ambiguity effectively.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and judgment.
* Demonstrate the behaviors of a true team player and a guardian of the Whatfix culture, consistently role-modelling collaboration, ownership, integrity, and professionalism

**Perks & Benefits (India)**

* Best-in-class medical insurance coverage
* Free lunch & dinner buffet
* Doorstep cab drop facility
* Education sponsorship
* Internal job transfer programs

**Note:**

* We strive to live and breathe our Cultural Principles and encourage employees to demonstrate some of these core values - Customer First; Empathy; Transparency; Fail Fast and scale Fast; No Hierarchies for Communication; Deep Dive and innovate; Trust, Do it as you own it;
* We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse people because of and not in spite of the differences. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status
* At Whatfix, we deeply value collaboration, innovation, and human connection. We believe that being together in the office five days a week fosters open communication, strengthens our sense of community, and accelerates innovation—ultimately helping us achieve our goals more effectively. At the same time, we recognize the importance of flexibility in balancing personal and professional priorities. To support this, we offer the option to work from home up to two days per month.
* In any situation that requires additional flexibility, we’re open to considering exceptions on a case-by-case basis to ensure you’re supported in managing both work and life seamlessly.

title: People Quality & Effectiveness Expert
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**Hello** . We’re **Haleon** . A new world-leading consumer health company. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people. By growing and innovating our global portfolio of category-leading brands – including **Sensodyne** , **Panadol** , **Advil** , **Voltaren** , **Theraflu** , **Otrivin** , and **Centrum** – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. Brands that are known and trusted to deliver. What’s more, whilst our brands have history, our company is new, fresh and forming, shaped by all who join us. We are at the forefront of building a new sector of consumer health and for Haleon, co-creating our unique culture. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.

This is an exciting time to join us and help shape the future. It’s an opportunity to be part of something special.

**About the team**

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.

We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.

Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.

The People Quality & Effectiveness team is responsible for setting our service standards, strengthening controls and driving continuous improvement across People Solutions. Team is responsible for building a consistent quality, effectiveness and governance framework that enables People Solutions to operate with clarity, control and scale, with digital as the front door and employee experience at the centre.

**About the role**

The **People Quality & Effectiveness Expert** is responsible for strengthening the quality, consistency and effectiveness of People Solutions services. Reporting to the Head of People Quality & Effectiveness, this role uses service data quality reviews, root cause analysis, HR controls, audit insight and customer feedback to identify what is working, what needs to improve and where action is needed.

Working as part of People Solutions Excellence, the role partners closely with Global Operations delivery teams, Global Process Owners, People Experience & Change, and specialist operations teams to help close the improvement loop, reduce friction and support more reliable, controlled and employee-centred services.

Key responsibilities:

* Support the delivery and execution of HR Controls across global services.

* Support audit readiness, control execution, compliance monitoring and evidence management across People Solutions services.

* Monitor service performance through KPIs, SLAs, NPS, dashboards, scorecards, quality reviews and trend analysis.

* Identify service gaps, quality issues, process exceptions and operational risks, using evidence-based insight to recommend practical improvements.

* Lead or support root cause analysis, ensuring findings are clearly documented, actions are agreed and lessons learned are shared.

* Track corrective and preventive actions, remediation plans and improvement commitments through to closure and effectiveness review.

* Maintain quality, RCA, controls, risk and action repositories so that information is clear, current and easy to act on.

* Support Business Continuity Planning activities including plan maintenance, testing, exercises, remediation tracking and reporting.

* Ensure our Quality Assurance Framework and Governance are implemented globally.

* Partner with Global Process Owners and service delivery teams to translate quality insight into process improvements, control enhancements and better employee and manager experiences.

* Prepare clear reporting and insight packs for governance forums, highlighting risks, themes, progress and recommended actions.

* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by challenging duplication, reducing friction and supporting standardised ways of working.

Role model Haleon behaviours by unlocking value at pace, collaborating for impact and growing yourself and others.  



**About you**

Technical and functional expertise:

* 8-10 years of experience in HR shared services, People Services, service delivery, operational excellence, quality, audit, compliance, risk or continuous improvement, ideally within global, complex environments.

* Good understanding of HR operations, service processes, controls and employee and manager experience.

* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends and turn insight into practical action.

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Microsoft Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development, visualisation and reporting. Practical experience using Microsoft Power Apps to build or enhance business applications and workflow solutions.

* Knowledge of quality management, audit, risk, compliance, business continuity and/or Lean Six Sigma methods. Professional certification or training in quality, risk, audit, project management or continuous improvement is advantageous.

Comfortable working with HR systems, reporting tools and service platforms such as Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI or equivalent tools.  



Leadership and behavioural capabilities:

* Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

* Strong communication and influencing capabilities with the confidence to explain issues clearly and work collaboratively with stakeholders across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.

* Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate competing priorities effectively.

* A continuous improvement mindset, with curiosity, practical problem-solving skills and a focus on making services simpler and better.

* Organised and detail-oriented with a focus on compliance, governance and operational excellence, and the ability to manage multiple priorities, track actions and follow through to completion.

Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.  



**Job Posting End Date**

2026-11-10  

**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
  
  
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.
  
  
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------

We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

**Note to candidates**
----------------------

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: ServiceNow Practice Head
description:
### **About InputZero**

InputZero Technologies is a ServiceNow Elite Partner and Enterprise Service Management company helping organizations transform and automate their IT and business workflows. Our capabilities span ServiceNow, BMC, AI, Automation, ITSM, ITOM, GRC and Enterprise Workflow solutions, with a strong focus on delivering outcome-driven solutions for global enterprises.

As we continue to expand our ServiceNow business and strengthen our global presence, particularly across North America, we are looking for an experienced ServiceNow Practice Head to lead and accelerate the growth of our ServiceNow practice.

### **Role Overview**

The ServiceNow Practice Head will have end-to-end ownership of the ServiceNow practice, including business growth, revenue, profitability, sales, presales, delivery governance, customer relationships, talent strategy and capability development.

This is a strategic leadership role for a business-oriented ServiceNow leader who can combine technology expertise, commercial acumen, sales leadership and delivery experience to build a scalable and profitable practice.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**1. Practice Strategy & Growth**

* Own and execute the overall ServiceNow practice strategy, roadmap and growth plan aligned with InputZero's business objectives.
* Drive year-on-year growth in revenue, profitability, market presence and customer base.
* Identify new markets, industries and ServiceNow opportunities to expand the practice.
* Develop differentiated ServiceNow offerings, solutions, accelerators and managed services.
* Drive both Net New Logo acquisition and expansion of existing strategic accounts.
* Build a strong and predictable ServiceNow pipeline in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams.
* Identify opportunities around emerging areas such as AI, GenAI, automation and enterprise workflow transformation.

**2. Revenue, P&L & Commercial Ownership**

* Own practice-level revenue, P&L, profitability, margins, utilization and commercial performance.
* Develop annual business plans, revenue targets and operating plans for the practice.
* Monitor pipeline, bookings, revenue forecasts, utilization and margins.
* Partner with Finance and Sales teams on pricing, commercial models and deal negotiations.
* Ensure the right balance between growth, delivery capacity, utilization and profitability.
* Establish appropriate business metrics and governance mechanisms to track practice performance.

**3. Sales, Presales & Deal Leadership**

* Partner with Sales and Business Development teams to identify, qualify and convert strategic ServiceNow opportunities.
* Act as the senior ServiceNow leader in RFPs, RFIs, proposals, solutioning and large deal pursuits.
* Lead executive-level solution discussions and customer presentations.
* Engage directly with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs and other senior business and technology stakeholders.
* Support commercial negotiations and develop compelling value propositions for enterprise customers.
* Drive account mining, cross-sell and up-sell opportunities.
* Build strong relationships with strategic customers, technology partners and the broader ServiceNow ecosystem.

**4. Delivery & Customer Success**

* Provide executive oversight for strategic ServiceNow programs and large customer engagements.
* Establish strong delivery governance, quality standards and operational processes.
* Ensure programs are delivered within agreed scope, timelines, budgets and quality expectations.
* Monitor project health, customer satisfaction, utilization, margins and delivery risks.
* Act as the senior escalation point for critical customer issues.
* Work closely with Delivery Heads, Program Managers, Architects and Account Leaders to resolve complex business and delivery challenges.
* Build long-term customer relationships and generate opportunities for account expansion and references.

**5. ServiceNow Capability & Offering Development**

* Build and strengthen capabilities across relevant ServiceNow areas including ITSM, ITOM, CSM, GRC, SecOps, HRSD, SPM and AI/Automation.
* Identify emerging ServiceNow products and market trends and convert them into commercially viable offerings.
* Develop reusable frameworks, accelerators, IP and industry-specific solutions.
* Strengthen InputZero's positioning as a strategic ServiceNow transformation partner, beyond traditional implementation services.
* Work closely with ServiceNow on partner programs, competencies, certifications, joint GTM initiatives and strategic opportunities.

**6. People & Practice Leadership**

* Build and lead a high-performing ServiceNow organization comprising Architects, Consultants, Developers, Business Analysts, Program Managers and Delivery Leaders.
* Develop workforce and hiring plans aligned with business pipeline and future capability requirements.
* Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, leadership development and employee retention.
* Establish a strong ServiceNow certification and continuous-learning culture.
* Monitor team utilization, productivity, capacity and skill availability.
* Develop future practice leaders and create a scalable organizational structure.

**7. Executive Stakeholder Management**

* Build trusted relationships with CXO-level customer stakeholders and strategic accounts.
* Represent InputZero in executive customer meetings, industry events and partner forums.
* Collaborate closely with the CEO, Sales, Delivery, HR, Finance and other business leaders.
* Provide regular leadership updates on practice revenue, pipeline, profitability, customer health, talent and strategic initiatives.
* Drive a culture of accountability, customer obsession and profitable growth.

### **Key Success Metrics**

Success in this role will be measured through:

* ServiceNow revenue and year-on-year growth
* Practice profitability and margins
* Net New Logos acquired
* Qualified pipeline and bookings
* Strategic deal closures
* Existing account growth and expansion
* Customer retention and satisfaction
* Practice utilization and productivity
* ServiceNow certifications and capability development
* Employee retention and leadership development
* ServiceNow partner performance and strategic relationship

  
**Requirements**  

### **Required Experience & Skills**

* 15+ years of overall IT/Technology Services experience, with significant experience in ServiceNow.
* Proven experience in building, scaling or leading a ServiceNow practice.
* Demonstrated experience in revenue ownership, P&L, business growth and practice management.
* Proven track record of new business acquisition and Net New Logo development.
* Strong experience in presales, solutioning, RFPs, proposals and commercial negotiations.
* Experience leading large and complex ServiceNow programs and distributed teams.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow platform and the broader enterprise transformation landscape.
* Strong understanding of the ServiceNow partner ecosystem and go-to-market model.
* Strong CXO-level customer engagement and executive communication skills.
* Experience working with global customers.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CIS, CAD or CTA.
* Experience across multiple ServiceNow product lines and ServiceNow Managed Services / AMS.
* Experience building ServiceNow accelerators, IP or industry-specific solutions.
* Exposure to AI, GenAI, automation and enterprise workflow transformation.
* Experience serving customers in North America.

title: IS Functional Analyst - ERP Technical Integration and BTP

**This position reports to:**

IS Service Manager

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**

In this role, you will be responsible for the design and build, integrity, and quality of an IS solution and associated IS services delivered to business. The primary role of IS Integration BTP is to be responsible for the definition and delivery Integration technology and architecture related to SAP BTP Integration Suite and SAP Integrations.

The work model for this role is: Hybrid in Cleveland or Cary.

The role is contributing to the **IS Services Division** in North America.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Evaluates emerging technologies and recommend improvements to existing systems and processes.

**Qualifications for the role**

  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field. Relevant certifications in SAP S/4 HANA Integration Certifications, SAP Certified Development Associate – SAP Extension Suite or IT architecture would be advantageous
* At least 5 years of experience in SAP Cloud Platform Integration, with at least 4 years in SAP PI/PO and SAP Integrations
* Solid understanding of SAP BTP administration
* Proven experience in leading system architecture teams and managing the full lifecycle of large-scale technology implementations, from design through to delivery.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex, cross-functional challenges.
* A strong focus on continuous improvement and automation, with a passion for driving innovation within enterprise systems.
* Extensive experience in developing and optimizing integration flows using Groovy scripting within SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI)
* Proficient in using API integration tools such as Postman and SOAP UI
* Experience in managing relationships with external vendors and third-party service providers to ensure the delivery of high-quality solutions
* Hands-on experience with SAP ABAP, Including FRICEW objects

title: Principal Data Governance Analyst
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

**The Opportunity:**

The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer is the senior technical authority responsible for connecting governed enterprise data and business meaning with scalable analytics and artificial intelligence solutions. This role defines the architecture, standards, and engineering patterns for semantic models, governed metrics, AI-ready data products, machine learning operations, and generative AI consumption.

Operating at the intersection of Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Governance, and AI Platform Engineering, this role ensures that enterprise data, metrics, models, and knowledge assets can be reliably discovered, understood, deployed, monitored, and reused. The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, guides complex implementations, and mentors engineers and analysts while remaining an individual contributor**.**

**What you’ll do…**

**Semantic Architecture & Governed Metrics**

* Define enterprise standards and reference patterns for semantic models, dimensional models, business metrics, KPIs, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable analytical assets.
* Architect semantic consumption patterns across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks Gold-layer data, and approved AI applications.
* Partner with business domain owners, analysts, and Data Governance to translate business concepts into consistent, governed definitions and analytical models.
* Lead design reviews for semantic models and analytical data products, balancing usability, reuse, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Ensure semantic assets are documented with appropriate metadata, lineage, ownership, and change controls.

**AI Engineering & MLOps**

* Define engineering standards for deploying, versioning, testing, monitoring, and governing machine learning and generative AI solutions.
* Architect reusable MLand LLM patterns, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, evaluation, observability, rollback, and production support.
* Guide implementation of feature pipelines, model registries, inference workflows, retrieval pipelines, vectorized knowledge assets, and AI evaluation frameworks.
* Partner with Data Scientists and AI product teams to move prototypes into secure, scalable, and supportable production services.
* Implement technical controls for traceability, reproducibility, model performance, data drift, responsible AI requirements, and operational reliability.

**AI-Ready Data & Knowledge Enablement**

* Design curated, governed data products and knowledge assets for predictive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.
* Define how structured data, enterprise metrics, metadata, documents, embeddings, and retrieval indexes are linked and consumed.
* Ensure AI applications use approved business definitions, metrics, access policies, and authoritative data sources.
* Collaborate with Architecture and Governance teams on ontology, glossary, metadata, lineage, classification, and policy integration.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Serve as the technical escalation point for complex semantic, analytics, MLOps, and AI engineering decisions.
* Create reference implementations, reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering playbooks.
* Mentor Senior Analytics & AI Engineers, Semantic Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.
* Influence cross-functional roadmaps and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic adoption paths aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

**Who you are?**

* 10+ years of experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, semantic modeling, data engineering, machine learning engineering, MLOps, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience serving as a principal-level technical leader or architect for enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic model design, analytical performance optimization, and governed metric implementation.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric semantic models, including DAX and enterprise-scale model design.
* Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and AI platform, including production data pipelines and model lifecycle capabilities.
* Experience designing or operating CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring, evaluation, and observability for ML or generative AI solutions.
* Working knowledge of generative AI patterns such as embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, prompt and model evaluation, and agent-based solutions.
* Strong understanding of metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, business glossary, and responsible AI principles.
* Proven ability to mentor technical professionals, lead architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and cloud observability tooling.
* Experience supporting enterprise Finance, GTM, Product, Customer, or Workforce analytics domains.
* Experience establishing reusable semantic or AI platform capabilities in a federated operating model.
