title: Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
CTI MD Tech@Lilly
  
Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev
  
**Management Level:** M1 | Job Family: Information Technology
  
  
**About the Organization:**  
CTI - Development owns the digital capability that patients, sites and study teams meet first: consent and data capture, patient engagement, and the systems that get a study designed, started and set up. The portfolio spans Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and patient engagement, and AI & Analytics. The organization is mid-transformation, modernizing platforms and scaling AI and agentic use cases while operating under strict GxP/GCP, data integrity and inspection-readiness requirements.
  
  
**Job Description:**  
The Associate Director, CTI - Development, Clinical Dev, leads a team of engineering, product and delivery professionals and owns delivery, technical direction and capability growth across the Trial Capabilities, Clinical Experience and AI & Analytics domains. The role sits where clinical process meets engineering: close enough to the build to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in trial execution to shape how a study team actually works. It owns the demand relationship with clinical development business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, manages allocated budget and contractor capacity against plan, and is expected to set the agenda for AI and agentic adoption rather than wait for direction on it. Hands-on technical experience is expected and non-negotiable: a practitioner who has built and shipped software and integrations directly, and who stays current enough to pressure-test an architecture or a build versus buy call. The role is scoped at the upper end of the band and is expected to grow into responsibility for broader teams as the portfolio expands.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities :**  
Delivery Ownership
  
  

* Own delivery execution across the portfolio (scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness, production health) for clinical experience and patient engagement products (eConsent, ePRO/eCOA, patient portals and apps) and study start-up capabilities (site activation, study build, CTMS/eTMF integration).
* Run the standing delivery cadence of operational reviews, backlog grooming, planning cycles (e.g., PI Planning) and release governance as a single portfolio-wide rhythm, and apply product-management rigor to prioritization, scoring business value, technical debt, effort and risk explicitly and agreeing success measures before work starts.
* Define and implement the portfolio metrics framework: release predictability, defect escape, production reliability, study build and site activation cycle time, and adoption by sites, study teams and patients. Instrument it where stakeholders can see it, not inside a backlog tool.
* Identify and solve organizational and operational problems and technical challenges across the portfolio, from resourcing conflicts and scope ambiguity to cross-team dependencies, escalating only what falls outside established guidelines and doing so with a recommendation.

Technical Direction & Engineering Standards
  
  

* Set and defend the technical direction of the portfolio; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, interoperability (CDISC, HL7/FHIR) and reuse across clinical platforms.
* Own the architecture and design decisions for the portfolio's products, approve solution and integration designs, and run a design review cadence that catches problems before a release rather than after one.
* Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt.
* Stay personally current: spend enough time in the code, the integrations and the production systems to judge an estimate, read a pull request and ask the questions only a practitioner asks.

AI & Agentic Transformation
  
  

* Define and land a 12 to 24 month vision for AI and agentic capability in study start-up and clinical experience: protocol and document intelligence, automated study build, site and patient-facing assistants. Make the business case for it.
* Find the use cases, prove them quickly at low cost, and take the ones that work through validation into production use with the evaluation, guardrails and human-in-the-loop design that requires.
* Build the team's AI fluency, make AI-assisted engineering the normal way of working, and partner with business owners to redesign clinical process rather than automate around it.

Resource, Budget & Vendor Management
  
  

* Forecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage allocated budget and contractor capacity within approved guidelines, including allocation, ramp-up and release decisions.
* Own vendor and partner delivery: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams, and manage performance on predictability and quality.
* Own SOW/MSA follow-ups, renewals and scope amendments, shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.

Business Stakeholder Engagement
  
  

* Act as the technology partner for business owners and study teams: the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Represent the portfolio externally with platform vendors, sites and industry forums, influencing partner roadmaps toward Lilly's needs.
* Run the demand relationship: capture and challenge incoming requests, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Contribute to the Clinical Dev business-area plan by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced delivery cycles.
* Translate clinical need into technical options, and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on, with no surprises at release.

People Leadership
  
  

* Hold management responsibility for the team, including hiring, onboarding, goal-setting and performance appraisals; hire for the capability the portfolio needs next, such as AI engineering, product thinking and clinical domain depth.
* Coach and develop through specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own; serve as career advisor and partner with HR on growth plans.
* Grow engineering craft, not only careers: use design and code review as teaching moments, and build shared practice across internal pods and partner teams so good patterns spread.
* Build bench strength and succession, remove single points of failure, and lead through senior engineers, technical leads and partner pod leads as the portfolio grows, setting direction for work executed beyond direct line management.

Quality, Compliance & Process Leadership
  
  

* Deliver in a GxP/GCP-regulated environment covering computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness; design for security and patient data privacy from the start; own incident response and the service levels agreed with study teams.
* Implement and refine a standard framework for backlog management, delivery governance and execution (Agile/Kanban, PI Planning), and own the portfolio-level leadership reporting cadence.

**Required Skills and Expertise :**  

* 10+ years of relevant experience in technology delivery, engineering leadership or product/platform management, including 4+ years of people-leadership experience managing technical teams.
* Deep, current, hands-on engineering background: able to build, review and troubleshoot services, APIs and integrations, not solely credentialed from past roles. Fluency in at least one modern programming language and SQL, with working command of cloud platforms and integration patterns.
* Proven experience taking AI, machine learning or agentic solutions beyond proof of concept into governed production use.
* Experience managing vendor and contractor relationships, including SOW/MSA administration within established commercial guidelines, and forecasting resource needs against an allocated budget.
* Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship: shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.
* Demonstrated experience defining delivery or product metrics frameworks that stakeholders actually use.
* Demonstrated success building and retaining a technical team: hiring engineers, coaching through design review, and keeping critical talent.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices, with fluency in Agile/Kanban delivery and tooling (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow or equivalent).
* Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, clinical and regulatory language.

**Preferred Skills:**  

* 4+ years supporting clinical development technology: study start-up, site activation, patient- or site-facing systems, or clinical data capture.
* Experience with Veeva Vault Clinical, Medidata or comparable clinical platforms, working knowledge of clinical data standards (CDISC CDASH/SDTM, HL7/FHIR), and exposure to decentralized or hybrid trial designs.

**Education & Experience:**  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering or a related field (Master's preferred); Agile or PMP certification a plus.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform, shaping technical direction from direct engineering experience.

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Benefits
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, **Rippling has raised $1.85B+** from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead a high-impact platform engineering team responsible for core infrastructure and product foundations used across Rippling. This role owns multiple horizontal charters, including Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service. These systems sit at the intersection of platform scalability, developer productivity, compliance, configuration management, and customer-facing product quality. The ideal candidate is a strong engineering leader who can operate across ambiguous problem spaces, partner deeply with product and infrastructure teams, and build durable systems that scale with Rippling’s product surface.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead and grow a team of engineers working on critical platform charters.
* Own technical strategy and execution for Data Deletion, Webscripts, Internationalisation, and Rippling Config Service.
* Partner with product, design, compliance, security, and infrastructure teams to define roadmaps and delivery plans.
* Drive architecture reviews and ensure systems are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and secure.
* Establish clear ownership, operational excellence, and engineering quality across multiple platform surfaces.
* Balance short-term product needs with long-term platform investments.
* Mentor senior engineers and engineering leads, helping them grow their technical judgment and leadership.
* Improve execution rigor through planning, prioritization, metrics, incident reviews, and continuous process improvement.
* Represent the team in cross-functional forums and communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leadership.

### **What We’re Looking For**

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineering teams.
* Experience leading platform, infrastructure, developer productivity, or shared product-surface teams.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to reason about distributed systems, data models, APIs, reliability, and scale.
* Proven ability to lead ambiguous, cross-functional charters with multiple stakeholders.
* Experience managing senior engineers and driving alignment across teams.
* Strong execution discipline: roadmap planning, project delivery, operational metrics, and incident follow-through.
* Ability to balance product velocity with long-term platform quality.
* Clear written and verbal communication, especially around tradeoffs and technical strategy.

### **Nice To Have**

* Experience with privacy, compliance, data lifecycle, or data deletion systems(GDPR, CCPA).
* Experience building internal platforms or frameworks used by many product teams.
* Experience with internationalisation/localisation systems.
* Experience with configuration platforms, feature/config rollout systems, or policy/config management.
* Experience with low-code, scripting, workflow, or extensibility platforms.

### **Why This Role Matters**

This team builds foundational systems that many Rippling products depend on. The role requires someone who can think like a platform owner: creating leverage for other teams, reducing duplication, improving reliability, and ensuring that core systems continue to scale as Rippling grows across products, countries, and customer segments.

### **About You**

You are a hands-on engineering leader who enjoys operating at both technical and organizational levels. You can dive into architecture when needed, but your real strength is creating clarity, building strong teams, and helping engineers deliver high-quality systems in complex environments.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com

title: Manager I, Project Management
description:
Job Description:

The **BTEX Transformation Project Lead** serves as the program delivery owner for strategic initiatives across Schneider Electric's global Business Travel & Expense program. The role is accountable for delivering BTEX transformation initiatives and converting travel, expense, payment, and operational data into actionable business intelligence, driving process optimization, digital innovation, and measurable business outcomes.

Working across regions and functions, the role will lead global delivery governance, conduct end-to-end T&E data and process mining assessments, and introduce AI-enabled innovation that improves employee experience, operational efficiency, cost transparency, compliance, and decision-making.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Program Delivery Ownership**
---------------------------------

* Own the end-to-end delivery of global BTEX transformation program projects from initiation through implementation, stabilization, and benefits realization.
* Define and maintain integrated delivery plans covering scope, milestones, budget, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and acceptance criteria.
* Establish delivery governance, workstream cadence, decision forums, executive status reporting, and escalation mechanisms.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners to ensure timely delivery, clear accountability, and rapid issue resolution.
* Monitor delivery performance and business outcomes; implement corrective actions when milestones, quality, adoption, or value realization are at risk.

**2. Global T&E Process Mining and Process Excellence**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead global process mining assessments across travel booking, corporate card, expense submission, approval, audit, reimbursement, accounting, and payment processes.
* Define process-mining scope, required event data, process variants, control points, performance indicators, and target outcomes in partnership with process and data owners.
* Identify bottlenecks, rework, manual activities, policy deviations, control gaps, and automation opportunities across countries and regions.
* Translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps, standardized processes, control enhancements, and measurable efficiency initiatives.
* Embed continuous monitoring and value tracking to sustain improvements after implementation.

**3. AI-Enabled Ways of Working and Project Delivery**
------------------------------------------------------

* Embed AI into BTEX ways of working to improve productivity, collaboration, decision-making, and execution.
* Apply AI tools across project management activities, including planning, meeting preparation, documentation, status reporting, risk identification, action tracking, and stakeholder communication.
* Identify repetitive or manual activities that can be simplified or automated using approved AI capabilities.
* Promote practical AI adoption by developing reusable prompts, templates, working practices, and guidance for the BTEX team.
* Partner with Digital, Data, Cybersecurity, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance teams to ensure responsible and secure use of AI.
* Track the adoption and measurable impact of AI on project efficiency, delivery quality, employee experience, and business outcomes.

**4. Business Analysis, Data and Value Realization**
----------------------------------------------------

* Translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, process designs, data needs, and implementation priorities.
* Use travel, expense, card, supplier, policy, and operational data to validate improvement opportunities and support delivery decisions.
* Define program KPIs, baselines, target benefits, adoption measures, and post-implementation performance reviews.
* Partner with analytics teams to develop executive reporting and decision-support views that demonstrate progress and realized value.

**5. Stakeholder, Change and Adoption Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Build alignment with global and regional stakeholders across Finance, Procurement, Treasury, Accounting, HR, Digital, Compliance, Security, Sustainability, and business operations.
* Lead requirements workshops, process reviews, design sessions, governance meetings, and executive steering updates.
* Develop change, communication, training, readiness, and adoption plans appropriate to impacted audiences.
* Act as a trusted delivery partner who balances global standardization, local requirements, user experience, governance, and implementation feasibility.

**6. Technology and Vendor Delivery Management**
------------------------------------------------

* Manage delivery coordination with technology providers, travel management companies, payment partners, and implementation vendors.
* Clarify deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, quality expectations, testing requirements, and acceptance criteria.
* Support solution evaluation and ensure vendor commitments remain aligned with BTEX architecture, governance, integration, security, and business requirements.

===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately five years of professional experience in project coordination, business analysis, data analytics, process improvement, digital transformation, or a related area.
* Experience supporting projects through planning, requirements gathering, status tracking, testing, implementation, and follow-up.
* Working knowledge of project management fundamentals, including milestones, risks, dependencies, actions, and stakeholder reporting.

We do that by securing and retaining strategic skills, advancing our culture through engagement, and by raising the bar on performance. Join us redefine what’s next for you.**

**Job Family Definition:**

Responsible for the design, implementation and maintenance of human resources administration and activities associated with employee information, retrieval capabilities and support. Processes HR data according to ‘the company’ policy and legal requirements, consults on HR processes and implementation, and is responsible for end-to-end HR customer support throughout the employee life cycle. Identifies emerging applications and recommends process improvements and simplification that support business and HR strategy. Works across the business, functional, and regional areas of ‘the company’ to recommend IT investments and improvements to HR tools. Implements and tracks programs and processes to ensure that records are accurate, accessible, and appropriately secure, and that data retrieval and reporting capabilities meet the needs of internal customers, legal compliance, and the company policy requirements (e.g., data management and integration of data). Re-engineers processes at regional and country level and works in partnership with global teams to build more process strength and capability. Provides support for recruiting in administration, internal hiring and lower-level external hiring. Ensures seamless support through Contact HR for both front- and back-end processes. Defines the strategy for HR Operations support of Mergers, Acquisitions, Divestitures and Outsourcing (MADO). Leads, coordinates and provides HR Operations support for all MADO employee transitions.

**Management Level Definition:**

Applies intermediate subject matter knowledge to solve routine issues within established guidelines. Typically supervises non-exempt individual contributors in single functional area. Provides immediate supervision to a small tactical team of non-exempt employees engaged in supporting the day-to-day efforts of the department. Employees are usually all direct reports. Requires mentoring and guidance on handling new situations. Escalates issues where known precedent has not been established.

**What you’ll do:**

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end to end HR operations across employee life cycle including onboarding, data changes, job and positions updated, transfers, promotion and other employee transactions.
* Supervises transactions and monitors accordance with procedures and country-specific regulations.
* Coaches non-exempt employees and instructs team on processes, databases, and procedures.
* Identifies opportunities for process standardization and improvement within given scope; identifies core activities for business leaders and incorporates them into work plans.
* Partners with internal and external clients to assist in identifying process capabilities to meet process needs.
* Prepares monthly performance reports.
* Maintain high levels of data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with applicable employment regulations and internal policies.
* Identify opportunities to simplify standardize and optimize HR processes to improve efficiency, quality, scalability and employee experience.
* Partner with HR Business partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Total Rewards, Legal, Compliance, and Business leaders to ensure seamless HR service delivery.
* Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, inclusion, and operational excellence.
Drive employee engagement, change readiness, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

title: Senior HR Business Partner (Asia)_Director_HR Business Partners
description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as an HR Business Partner in the HR Service Delivery team, which provides tactical support to the core HR Business Partner team. Working very closely with senior HR Business Partners, this role offers a blend of HR operations and tactical advisory support to the Core HRBPs across the globe.

  
  

In the Human Capital Management division, we provide advice and insight to attract, retain, reward and develop a talented global workforce, giving employees the support and tools, they need to succeed. This is a Director level position within the HR Service Delivery team, providing a blend of operational and tactical support to the core HR Business Partner team as an extension of their team, and delivering end-to-end core HR support to business leaders, managers and employees in the assigned client groups. As we are building this team in India, the role is evolving and its scope will develop over time. This will be a gradual journey towards an optimized operating model, and the incumbent will play an active part in shaping how the team works and the support it provides. This role is for an experienced, hands-on HR generalist who thrives close to the people agenda: advising leaders and employees, resolving employee relations matters, and turning business needs into practical people solutions. The ideal candidate leads with empathy, asks the right questions, and responds quickly as the business, the organization and the industry evolve.

  
  

Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.

  
  

**What you'll do in the role:**

* Work hand in hand with the core HR Business Partner team as part of HR Service Delivery, providing tactical and operational support across the core HR function and employee lifecycle, sharing insights from the ground, and executing people priorities for the client group.
* Manage day-to-day HR operations for the client group located across different regions, including employee lifecycle activities such as onboarding, transfers, promotions, manager changes, compensation actions, mobility and separations, ensuring accuracy, timely completion and strong governance.
* Track requests through to completion, maintain accurate data in HR systems, and provide reporting, metrics and insights to the core HR Business Partner team and stakeholders.
* Serve as a trusted, hands-on advisor to business leaders, managers and employees on the full range of people matters, building strong relationships grounded in credibility, discretion and trust.
* Support employee relations: handle grievances, conduct and performance concerns, investigations and disciplinary matters fairly and consistently, partnering with Employee Relations, Legal and Compliance and ensuring outcomes are well-documented and aligned with policy and local labour law.
* Act as a solution provider: listen carefully, ask probing questions to understand the root cause, and recommend practical, balanced solutions that meet both business needs and employee wellbeing.
* Respond quickly and with agility to changing business priorities, organisational changes and industry developments, adapting people plans and advice accordingly.
* Partner with the business on organisational change, including restructures, team transitions, role changes and workforce planning, ensuring thoughtful change management and clear communication with impacted employees.
* Drive the annual and cyclical talent processes for the client group, including year-end performance evaluations, talent reviews, promotions, compensation and succession planning.
* Use people data and employee feedback to identify trends (e.g., attrition, engagement, ER patterns), anticipate risks and proactively recommend actions.
* Partner with global and regional HR colleagues to localise and land firm-wide people initiatives effectively.
* Actively represent HR Service Delivery in key forums, bringing forward the team’s perspective and ensuring operational insights inform broader discussions, priorities, and decisions
* Contribute to building and maturing the HR Service Delivery team in India, helping define processes, ways of working and the evolving scope of support as the team moves towards an optimised operating model.
  

  

**What you'll bring to the role:**

* 12 to 14 years' progressive HR experience, with significant time in a hands-on HR Business Partner or HR generalist role supporting senior business leaders.
* Experience working in an HR Service Delivery or HR operating model that supports senior HR Business Partners, with the ability to work closely and collaboratively alongside them.
* A balanced blend of HR operations and HR advisory experience, with strong process discipline, attention to detail and ownership of execution.
* Deep, practical experience in employee relations, including managing investigations, disciplinary and grievance cases, and sound working knowledge of Indian labour laws and employment practices.
* Proven ability to advise both business leaders and employees, balancing commercial priorities with fairness and employee experience.
* A solution-oriented mindset with strong judgement, able to diagnose issues and recommend pragmatic, well-reasoned options.
* Agility and pace: comfortable responding quickly to shifting business needs, ambiguity and change in the organisation and industry.
* Comfort working in a newly established, evolving team, with the flexibility and builder mindset to help shape processes and ways of working as the role and operating model mature.
* Strong influencing, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively.
* Experience in change management and organisational design is highly desirable.
* Prior experience supporting Financial Services or a global, matrixed organisation is preferred.
* Working knowledge of HR systems (e.g., Workday) and comfort using data and analytics to inform decisions; strong Microsoft Office skills.
* Utmost discretion and integrity in handling confidential and sensitive information.Hiring manager to add Hiring manager to add

title: Senior P&C Coordinator
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the** **Position**

As Senior P&C Coordinator, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the employee experience at Energy Exemplar, supporting assigned business functions across India. As the day-to-day P&C contact for managers and employees, you’ll build trusted relationships, understand team priorities and turn employee feedback and people data into practical recommendations that make a difference.

You’ll take ownership of key moments in the employee journey, from welcoming new starters and supporting probation through to offboarding, coordinating with relevant teams to deliver a smooth and positive experience. You’ll also help bring people programmes to life, guide managers through established policies and processes, and partner with the Senior Director, P&C on sensitive or complex matters.

This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems and taking initiative. How you work matters as much as what you deliver. We are looking for someone who brings a positive, constructive attitude, contributes to team success, actively seeks and applies feedback, and takes initiative to follow things through. The role offers opportunities to broaden your contribution and responsibility as you demonstrate sound judgment, consistent delivery and impact.

  

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**

* Provide quality, timely and professional P&C advice to managers and employees on established people processes and policies and build effective working relationships with stakeholders across assigned functions.

* Partner with managers to understand business priorities, team capability needs, employee motivations and retention risks, and help translate these into practical people actions for their teams.

* Support the delivery of performance and development processes, including goal and review cycles, development plans, talent discussions and follow-up on agreed actions.

* Work with managers to interpret engagement survey results and employee feedback, identify themes, agree relevant actions and monitor progress.

* Be accountable for the onboarding experience for employees, including Energy Exemplar’s sign-to-start programme, manager readiness, induction coordination and probation follow-up. Identify opportunities to improve the new-joiner experience.

* Conduct 30, 60 and 90 day new-joiner check-ins to assess the onboarding experience, identify issues requiring follow-up and share themes with managers and P&C leadership.

* Coordinate employee changes and offboarding, conduct exit interviews where appropriate, and identify themes and recommendations for action.

* Ensure the accurate and timely administration and safekeeping of employee records, HRIS information and documentation in line with local requirements and Global P&C processes.

* Produce accurate and informative reports, including headcount, attrition, onboarding, engagement and employee movements, and share insights and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.

* Collaborate with the Global P&C team and internal partners to deliver consistent people processes and employee experiences across locations and suggest improvements to established practices.

* Escalate sensitive employee relations matters, disciplinary issues, separations, compensation or policy exceptions, and significant people risks to the Senior Director, P&C for review and decision.

* Use approved AI tools where appropriate to improve the quality and efficiency of P&C communications, reporting, analysis and routine workflows; verify outputs before use and protect confidential employee information.

  

**Candidate Requirements**

* Constructive attitude and teamwork: Approaches challenges with a practical, solution-focused mindset, supports colleagues and contributes to shared outcomes. Willingly takes on the detailed and routine work needed to deliver a strong employee experience.

* Coachability and self-awareness: Actively seeks feedback, listens openly, takes responsibility for errors and demonstrates how learning translates into improved performance.

* Initiative and follow-through: Identifies what needs attention, recommends practical action and follows through on commitments without repeated prompting. Knows when to act independently and when to seek guidance.

* Learning and growth: Shows curiosity about the business and the P&C profession, applies new learning and builds credibility through the quality and impact of their work.

* Collaborative confidence: Listens to different perspectives, shares credit and adapts their approach when presented with better information. Can respectfully question an approach and offer an alternative.

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist or people advisory role, including direct support to managers; experience in a product technology or software environment is an advantage.

* Working understanding of India employment practices, HR compliance and relevant labour legislation, with the judgment to recognise when specialist advice is needed.

* Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, performance and engagement programmes, and interpreting people data to recommend actions.

* Ability to build trust with managers and employees, ask thoughtful questions, communicate clearly and follow issues through to resolution.

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to balance portfolio priorities and deliver accurate work in a changing environment.

* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with BambooHR or a similar HRIS is desirable.

* AI readiness: confidence using approved AI tools for drafting, analysis and routine workflows; ability to write useful prompts, verify results against source information, recognise errors or bias, and handle employee data in line with company requirements.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management or related field

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

title: Global Process Owner - Organisation Design
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the team**

People Solutions Excellence exists to drive executional excellence in HR operations, services and transactions. We help improve how People Solutions operates by making processes simpler, services better, decisions more data-driven, and change more successful.

We're a global team of experts in process improvement, people experience, service excellence, data and analytics, reporting, and project delivery. Working closely with our HR Centres of Excellence and People Solutions teams, we solve problems, streamline ways of working, and drive continuous improvement.

Our role is to create consistent, scalable solutions that work globally while allowing for local needs where required. We bridge the gap between business requirements and operational delivery; helping People Solutions deliver better experiences, stronger outcomes, and lasting adoption of change.

Our Global Process Owners (GPOs) in our Global Process Solutions team are critical to helping us deliver this ambition; ensuring business need is translated into clear, standardised and scalable process solutions, enabling consistent ways of working and driving improved service outcomes.

**About the role**

As **GPO for Organisation Design** , you will be responsible for partnering closely with the Organisational Effectiveness team and Tech colleagues to design, govern and continuously improve how we manage our organisational blueprint (including supervisory structures, position management, cost centre alignment, business entity management) across the globe, and ensure we have clearly governed, and robust solutions for effectively managing HR colleague access to employee data.

Key responsibilities:

* Own the end-to-end global organisational blueprint process framework, driving standardisation, governance and continuous improvement across all markets.

* Define, maintain and optimise organisational change processes, ensuring they are efficient, scalable, compliant and aligned with Haleon’s operating model.

* Act as subject matter expert for supervisory organisation, position management, cost centre alignment, business entity management and HR security and access management processes, providing guidance and decision-making support to Organisational Effectiveness, People Solutions, HR teams, Digital & Technology teams and business stakeholders.

* Partner with HR Business Partners, Organisational Effectiveness, People Solutions, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and Digital & Technology teams to drive process simplification, automation and service excellence.

* Establish and maintain global process standards, controls, policies, Knowledge contents and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring consistency while balancing local regulatory and legislative requirements.

* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, leveraging process analytics, automation opportunities and industry best practices to improve employee experience, organisational blueprint integrity and operational efficiency.

* Ensure compliance with legislation, labour laws, local regulations, statutory obligations and Haleon policies across all relevant jurisdictions.

* Partner with the Quality & Effectiveness team to define and monitor key process performance indicators (KPIs), service level agreements (SLAs), quality metrics and payroll accuracy measures, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.

* Lead process governance forums and stakeholder engagement activities, ensuring alignment of process priorities, change initiatives and business requirements.

* Partner with Digital & Technology teams to help shape the organisation design and systems roadmap.

* Provide process leadership for technology enhancements, integrations and digital transformation initiatives.

* Ensure robust governance and integrity of organisational structure data across HR, payroll, finance and workforce management platforms.

* Support acquisitions, divestitures, organisational redesigns and transformation programs impacting organisational blueprint processes.

Collaborate with vendors, consultants and implementation partners to evaluate and adopt best-in-class solutions and practices.  

  

**About you**

**Technical and functional expertise:**

· 8+ years of relevant experience in organisation design/effectiveness, HR Operations, Shared Services, Process Ownership or related disciplines.

· Strong expertise in global organisation design operations, workforce management processes and security and access controls.

· Experience operating within complex global organisations, ideally using multiple vendors and service delivery models.

· Proven experience leading global process ownership, governance and standardisation initiatives.

· Strong understanding of Workday and organisation design-related integrations, with the ability to assess process, data and system impacts.

· Experience working with global design systems such as OrgVue.

· Demonstrable experience leveraging data analytics and process insights to drive business performance improvements.

· Knowledge of automation, digital transformation and emerging technologies impacting HR Operations and Shared Services.

· Certification in process improvement methodology (e.g. Lean Six Sigma) is advantageous.

**Leadership and behavioural capabilities:**

· Exceptional stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

· Strong communication and influencing capabilities across global, virtual and cross-functional environments.

· Ability to influence without direct authority and navigate competing priorities effectively.

· Curious, proactive and solutions-focused, with a continuous improvement mindset.

· Resilient and adaptable, able to navigate ambiguity and changing business needs.

· Demonstrates accountability and ownership for delivering results.

· Strong commercial thinking, analytical capability and problem-solving skills.

· High attention to detail with a focus on compliance, governance and operational excellence.

* Demonstrable capability to lead change, drive adoption and deliver sustainable business outcomes, preferably in complex environments.

2026-10-29

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.

title: Senior Business Operations Specialist
description:

**Overview:**

  
  

As a leading global aerospace company, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. As a top U.S. exporter, the company leverages the talents of a global supplier base to advance economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing’s team is committed to innovating for the future, leading with sustainability, and cultivating a culture based on the company’s core values of safety, quality and integrity.

  
  

**Technology for today and tomorrow:**

  
  

The Boeing India Engineering & Technology Center (BIETC) is a 5500+ engineering workforce that contributes to global aerospace growth. Our engineers deliver cutting-edge R&D, innovation, and high-quality engineering work in global markets, and leverage new-age technologies such as AI/ML, IIoT, Cloud, Model-Based Engineering, and Additive Manufacturing, shaping the future of aerospace.

People-driven culture

  
  

At Boeing, we believe creativity and innovation thrives when every employee is trusted, empowered, and has the flexibility to choose, grow, learn, and explore. We offer variable arrangements depending upon business and customer needs, and professional pursuits that offer greater flexibility in the way our people work. We also believe that collaboration, frequent team engagements, and face-to-face meetings bring together different perspectives and thoughts – enabling every voice to be heard and every perspective to be respected. No matter where or how our teammates work, we are committed to positively shaping people’s careers and being thoughtful about employee wellbeing.

  
  

With us, you can create and contribute to what matters most in your career, community, country, and world. Join us in powering the progress of global aerospace.

  
  

The **BGES (Boeing Global Enterprise Services) Business Operations Specialist** will be responsible to support the Global Workplace Strategy & Operations team by driving operational excellence, enabling safe and efficient workplace services, and ensuring consistent execution of business processes across India region. The role is a key connector between cross‑functional partners, site operations, sustainability programs, and all leadership initiatives.

  
  

The **Business Operations Specialist** , will assist in the development and integration of programs, plans, strategies and processes to meet business goals such as sourcing strategy, cost imperatives, deployment analysis and impact mitigation. Will coordinate with various teams and leads to collect data, analyze the data and support development of business cases and performance analytics to meet long range business goals. Coordinates the commitments with internal and external organizations to fulfill strategies where BGES plays either a supporting or leading role. Identifies risk and opportunity potential, develops mitigation planning and refines the business case. Collects, organizes and provides data according to established processes within the management system to maintain status of programs, customer and supplier commitments and compliance. Ensures follow up action for issue resolution. Provides coaching and guidance to less experienced personnel.

  
  

**Position Responsibilities:**

  
  

**1. Operational Excellence & Process Improvement**

* Support implementation of the BGES Operating Model focused on *cost‑effective operations, people & leadership, and service excellence*
* Program manages the operational excellence projects for the region
* Coordinate PMBP/CI workshops, problem‑solving sessions, and performance reviews as and when applicable
  

  

**2. Business Performance & Governance**

* Maintain Tiered scorecards, operational dashboards, and service performance metrics associated with BGES service delivery and governance routines.
* Responsible and accountable for global reporting
* Assist in value engineering initiatives and cost‑driver analysis to meet BGES Enterprise Operational Excellence (EOE) priorities.
* Track risks, mitigation plans, and project actions for site and enterprise programs (as seen in BGES India project governance templates).
  

  

**3. Cross‑Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with HR, Finance, GREF, PMCM, IT Ops, ISC, Ethics, GSA, and business units to ensure aligned service delivery and project execution.
* Responsible to manage the operating rhythms for the region and cross functional governance including tier 5 reporting
* Support stakeholder communication and engagement across regions and service lines
  

  

**4. Program & Project Support**

* Assist with planning, tracking, and reporting for operational programs, transition plans, walkthroughs, and readiness activities across Boeing sites.
* Coordinate cross‑regional efforts including sustainability initiatives, energy‑tracking activities, Green Team engagement, and compliance reporting (EED, MEES, renewable energy milestones).
  

  

**5. Workplace Strategy & Site Operations Support**

* Provide structured business support for day‑to‑day site operational needs including onboarding, services coordination, and vendor alignment.
* Contribute to global workplace strategy execution by capturing requirements, supporting major projects, and ensuring alignment to business priorities.
* Works with the manager to develop people engagement plans
  

  

**6. Communication & Reporting**

* Prepare leadership updates, governance decks, and operational summaries for monthly BGES councils and governance meetings such as:
* Provide structured communication to stakeholders during transitions, audits, readiness reviews, and implementation cycles.
  

  

**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**

* Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; ability to interpret operational and financial data.
* Experience in Lean, Kaizen, PMBP, or continuous improvement tools (preferred).
* Excellent cross‑functional communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to work in a fast‑paced, multi‑region operational environment.
* High proficiency in MS365 tools (Excel, Power BI, SharePoint, PowerPoint).
* Understanding of workplace services, facilities operations, or sustainability programs is a plus.
* Knowledge of management of ServiceNow working with IT development teams

description:
The Senior Manager, IGA is a senior technical and client-facing leadership role focused on driving Identity Governance and Administration engagements from strategy through execution, with SailPoint and Saviynt as core platforms of expertise. This role requires the ability to lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients – translating complex governance, compliance, and identity lifecycle requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures. While IGA is the primary focus, the ideal candidate also brings working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains, including Privileged Access Management (PAM) and Access Management (SSO/MFA), to design cohesive, end-to-end identity solutions. The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to client stakeholders, architect enterprise-grade IGA solutions, and lead cross-functional delivery teams, while also contributing to business development, proposal development, and practice growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead technical architecture design sessions directly with clients, translating business, security, and compliance requirements into scalable IGA target-state architectures.
* Architect and oversee end-to-end implementation of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions using SailPoint and Saviynt as primary platforms.
* Design and lead delivery of core IGA capabilities, including identity lifecycle management (Joiner/Mover/Leaver), access certification/attestation campaigns, role-based access control (RBAC) and role mining, Segregation of Duties (SoD) policy design, entitlement management, and access request/approval workflows.
* Lead application onboarding strategy for IGA platforms, including source/target connector design, birthright and non-birthright provisioning, and integration with authoritative HR sources
* Define and implement IGA governance frameworks, including policy design, audit and compliance reporting, and global configuration/data segmentation best practices.
* Working knowledge of adjacent IAM domains – Privileged Access Management (PAM, e.g., CyberArk, Delinea) and Access Management (SSO/MFA via Entra ID, Okta, Ping) – to ensure IGA architectures integrate cleanly across the broader identity ecosystem.
* Own end-to-end delivery for engagements, managing scope, timelines, technical quality, and client satisfaction.
* Serve as the primary technical point of contact for clients, running architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and executive-level readouts.
* Develop maturity assessments, governance roadmaps, and target operating models tailored to client environments and industry (e.g., healthcare, higher education, financial services).
* Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and career development to IAM engineers, architects, and consultants on the delivery team.
* Partner with sales and account teams on business development activities, including solution scoping, proposal/SOW development, and technical presentations for prospective clients.
* Advise clients on regulatory and compliance considerations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR) as they relate to identity governance controls, certifications, and audits.
* Monitor emerging IGA trends and best practices (including AI-driven governance) and champion their adoption across client engagements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field.
* 10+ years of hands-on IAM experience with a strong concentration in Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), including consulting or client-facing delivery, and at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or architecture role.
* Deep, hands-on expertise architecting and implementing SailPoint and Saviynt, including certification campaigns, RBAC/SoD design, connector configuration, and workflow customization.
* Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, entitlement governance, access certification processes, and provisioning/de-provisioning across enterprise applications.
* Working knowledge of PAM concepts and platforms (e.g., CyberArk, Delinea, BeyondTrust) and Access Management/SSO technologies (e.g., Entra ID, Okta, Ping) sufficient to architect integrated IAM solutions.
* Proven ability to lead technical architecture discussions and design sessions directly with client stakeholders, including CISOs and IT leadership.
* Solid understanding of identity protocols and standards, including SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and LDAP.
* Experience managing project resources, timelines, and deliverables across multiple concurrent engagements.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring and developing technical teams, with strong people leadership skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.
* Relevant certifications strongly preferred (e.g., CISSP, CISM, SailPoint Certified, Saviynt Certified Professional).

title: Senior Global HR Specialist
description:
**Job Title**

Senior Global HR Specialist

**Job Description**

**So, who are we?**

  

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

  

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

  

Join us at IG – the future gets built here *.*

  

**Your team**

You’ll join People Services, part of People Excellence at IG, supporting 3,000+ colleagues across the globe.

  

**Your role in the Team's Success**

  

This is a 12-month fixed-term role, so you need to be productive from your first week. You’ll work independently from our documented procedures and take full ownership of the work you pick up. You’ll report to the Manager, HR Operation.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Resolve HR queries and requests in ServiceNow, accurately and within agreed timeframes
* Process employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, including hires, changes, and leavers
* Own the daily Workday task queue on your assigned days, including anything left over from the previous day
* Prepare, sign, and distribute accurate HR letters and documents, and maintain employee files in our online archive
* Support Japan HR Operations from November
* Handle correspondence from authorities and external bodies, making sure every item is resolved or escalated with a clear next step
* Support colleagues on complex cases and contribute to audits
Work with team members across India, Poland, and the UK  

  
  

**What you'll need**

  

* **You work out what to do when a case doesn’t match the procedure.** Procedures cover most cases but not all. When something differs, you work out the right action, or you escalate with your analysis and a proposed next step. You never close a case because “no instruction applies”.
* **You own the outcome.** If something is unowned or overdue, you pick it up. You don’t wait to be assigned it or assume someone else has it.
* **You flag risks early.** If you can’t meet a deadline or you’re unsure about a case, you tell your manager straight away, with a proposed way forward.
* **You work UK hours** one to two days in every two weeks.

  

**Essential**

  

* 4+ years of hands-on HR operations or HR shared services experience, ideally in a multi-country environment
* Hands-on experience with Workday or SuccessFactors
* Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, or a similar HR case management tool
* Strong written and spoken English (C1)
* Proven track record of working independently from procedures and handling cases that don’t fit them
Willingness to work UK hours as described above  

  

**Nice to have**

  

* Experience supporting APAC, EMEA, or Japan HR processes
* Experience handling correspondence from authorities and labour office
Experience supporting internal or external audits.  

  

**The Perks**

  

It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

  

**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**

  

**Number of openings**

1

description:

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

About Us
  
Sage helps small and mid-sized businesses make work and money flow. Our finance, HR, and payroll technology simplifies essential work and helps customers make decisions with confidence. We build with empathy, earn trust by delivering on our promises, and look for simpler ways to solve real problems. Across teams, we value curiosity, ownership, and ideas that improve the experience for customers and colleagues.
  
Our team builds Sage Expense Management, which helps finance teams manage spend from card transactions and receipt collection through policy checks, reimbursements, reconciliation, and accounting integrations. The platform also powers white-label and embedded experiences that banks, card issuers, and other partners offer to their customers.
  
What We’re Looking For
  
- You have 8+ years building software and 5+ years managing engineers across multiple engineering teams, including experience developing engineering managers or senior technical leaders.
  
- Technical depth in backend systems: strong experience with Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, and distributed systems, plus enough familiarity with Angular to guide frontend decisions and review work across the product.
  
- Hands-on engineering judgment: ability to work in the codebase, review design docs and pull requests, debug production issues, and improve performance and resilience.
  
- Visible leadership in AI-assisted engineering: use AI tools productively yourself, help engineers evaluate their output, and build team-level harnesses and workflows that improve quality and speed.
  
- Delivery ownership: break complex initiatives into milestones, make sound trade-offs, and maintain high standards for tests, automation, monitoring, and documentation.
  
- People leadership: coach engineers and managers, give clear feedback, support career growth, and participate in hiring.
  
- Cross-functional collaboration: communicate clearly with Product, Design, Support, go-to-market teams, external stakeholders, and other Sage Engineering groups.
  
What to Expect
  
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role. You’ll remain technically involved while giving engineers ownership, growing the team, and taking responsibility for delivery and long-term product health.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

The Impact You’ll Make
  
- Lead engineering teams building a product used by businesses across 39 countries.
  
- Stay hands-on across the stack: guide backend architecture and Angular frontend design, review critical changes, and help solve difficult production issues, write code where it matters.
  
- Build and operate services handling 7 million+ requests per day, with peaks above 1,000 requests per second. Own delivery and reliability from design through deployment, monitoring, and incident response.
  
- Partner with Product, Design, and go-to-market teams to turn customer needs into priorities and deliver useful features at scale.
  
- Build trusted relationships with customer and partner engineering teams and other external stakeholders. Work with wider Sage Engineering teams, including Cloud-Ops and Security, to align plans, commitments, and technical standards.

title: Associate Director, Service Ops Lead - Talent and L&D
description:
**About the Team:**

  

Enterprise Systems is the backbone of GSK’s internal operations in Digital & Tech, enabling GSK Global Functions teams such as Finance, Procurement, HR, Legal, Compliance, WREF, CGA and Corporate Secretariat to run seamlessly. This team designs and delivers cutting-edge digital platforms that power critical processes, ensuring efficiency, compliance, and scalability across the enterprise.

Our HR Digital & Tech team transforms how GSK attracts, develops, and retains talent through innovative technology solutions. From managing global HR platforms to delivering data-driven insights, this function ensures our people have the tools and experiences they need to thrive. Partnering closely with HR business teams, we create solutions that simplify processes, enhance employee engagement, and enable strategic workforce planning. If you’re passionate about technology that empowers people, this is where you can make an impact.

  

**Job Purpose:**

  

The Associate Director, Service Operations Lead – Talent & L&D is responsible for ensuring the stable, compliant, and reliable operation of select systems and platforms within the HR Digital & Tech domain. The role oversees day-to-day platform operations and ensures that processes are followed, risks are managed, and changes are delivered safely. It maintains the operational performance of multiple platforms (e.g. SuccessFactors), ensuring they meet agreed service levels and adhere to security and compliance expectations. The role also provides leadership across operational service teams and partner-delivered support services, ensuring effective service delivery, proactive issue management, continuous improvement, and strong coordination across business, technology, security, infrastructure, product, and vendor teams.

This role operates under GSK's "Performance with Choice" hybrid working approach, typically expecting 2–3 days per week in the office, with the specific pattern agreed between the successful candidate and their manager based on role and team needs.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide operational leadership across Talent & Data platforms, ensuring system stability, availability, and adherence to service levels, acting as the primary internal escalation point for product and domain teams on service performance and major incidents.
* Govern incident, problem, change, configuration, and release processes for domain platforms, ensuring operational compliance with ITSM policies and control frameworks, and defining measurable outcomes for problem management (e.g., RCA closure time, recurrence prevention, defect trend reduction).
* Define and maintain service readiness and runbook quality standards (e.g. ServiceNow Knowledge), ensuring escalation paths, support tasks, data handling, continuity steps, and deployment impacts are captured and validated before go-live.
* Create and oversee service plans for new and enhanced products, coordinating with Product Owners, third-party partners, and platform/service teams to define SLAs, performance expectations, and support handover criteria.
* Monitor platform performance, proactively identifying risks, trends, and recurring issues, and implement improvement actions to strengthen stability and user experience.
* Coordinate with Platform Owners, engineering squads, solution architects, and service teams to ensure changes, integrations, upgrades, and releases are deployed safely and meet operational readiness standards.
* Lead operational readiness assessments, ensuring documentation, support models, monitoring coverage, and non-functional controls are in place prior to deployment.
* Own operational dashboards, KPIs, and reporting for the platforms, ensuring performance, risks, and issues are communicated to senior stakeholders.
* Oversee root cause analysis for major incidents, ensuring sustainable fixes, clear remediation actions, and preventative measures are identified and delivered.
* Maintain and continuously improve operational documentation, including runbooks, support procedures, configuration inventories, and architectural operational views.
* Manage relationships with third-party vendors and managed service providers to ensure high-quality operational support and fulfilment of contractual obligations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate operational support teams and partner resources across areas such as service desk, platform support, infrastructure, cloud services, and application operations, ensuring clear accountability, timely delivery, and effective escalation management.
* Collaborate with security, risk, compliance, infrastructure, product, and engineering teams to ensure access controls, data handling, cyber security requirements, operational controls, and compliance standards are embedded into day-to-day service operations.
* Where required, support extended operational coverage, escalation, or on-call arrangements for critical incidents, major releases, or high-priority business events.
* Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements.
  

**Required Skills & Qualification:**

  

* **15–19 years of experience** in platform operations, system administration, IT service management, or technical delivery within complex enterprise environments, ideally supporting **SuccessFactors, Degreed, or similar HR/L&D platforms** .
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Strong knowledge of **platform operations, ITSM, cloud technologies, system integrations, monitoring, security, compliance, resilience, and business continuity** .
* Proven experience managing **incident, problem, change, release, and configuration management** , including root cause analysis and continuous improvement.
* Hands-on experience with **ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps** , monitoring platforms, knowledge management tools, or similar enterprise technologies.
* Experience leading operational support across multiple platforms and coordinating with **engineering, architecture, product, service desk, infrastructure, cloud, and third-party teams** .
* Strong service-management experience across **SLAs, KPIs, operational dashboards, incident trends, service performance, and operational risk indicators** .
* Experience managing **vendors, managed service providers, and SaaS partners** , including escalations, service quality, and continuous improvement.
* Experience developing operational documentation such as **runbooks, support procedures, and operational readiness assessments** .
* Experience working in **Agile/DevOps and fast-paced environments** , ensuring continuous delivery while maintaining platform reliability and user experience.
* Relevant certifications such as **ITIL, AWS/cloud, Agile/Scrum, DevOps Foundations, or equivalent** are desirable.
  

**Preferred Skills:**

  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, especially in complex operational scenarios.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide clarity during incidents and complex change cycles.
* Strong understanding of security, compliance, and operational risk controls.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams, influence without direct authority, and promote operational discipline.
* Effective organisational skills, able to balance multiple priorities and manage time-sensitive escalations.
* Strong leadership and coaching capability, with the ability to develop others, build collaboration, and create a high-performing service culture.
* Strong vendor, stakeholder, and relationship management skills, with the ability to influence outcomes and drive accountability across internal and external teams.
* Ability to work flexibly across time zones and support critical service events, releases, or escalations where required.
* Ability to work in a very fast-paced and fluid environment
Comfortable with ambiguity and change  

**Skills**

Degreed (Platform), Human Resources (HR) Technology, Incident Management, IT Service Management (ITSM), Major Incident Management, Operational Governance, Phenom (Platform), SAP SuccessFactors, Service Operations, Vendor Management  

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

The Corporate Functions Product Analyst supports the delivery of secure, effective, and compliant digital solutions by translating business strategy, pain points, and regulatory needs into clear, testable requirements. Working with both the Corporate Secretariat Product Owner and Communications & Governance Affairs Product Owner, helping to shape solution options that align to product strategy, architectural guardrails, and cost considerations. * Experience supporting functional testing activities, including executing test cases and managing defects through to resolution.
