title: Senior HR Business Partner (Tech + Ops)
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**

We're seeking a Senior HR Business Partner to support our rapidly growing R&D & Ops team in BLR. In this role, you’ll play a pivotal part in shaping our high-growth organization while contributing to the evolution of our HR function. As we build and scale to meet the dynamic needs of the business, you’ll have the opportunity to drive meaningful impact in a fast-paced and exciting environment. It’s an exciting time to join!  
  
**What you will do**

* Partner with Engineering & Ops leaders to translate business priorities and the broader HRBP roadmap into clear people recommendations and action plans for aligned India client groups.
* Serve as a trusted thought partner to leaders on organizational health, leadership effectiveness, performance, employee relations, and manager capability.
* Coach and advise managers on complex leadership and HR matters, including sensitive employee relations issues, performance challenges, team dynamics, and manager effectiveness.
* Independently drive defined HRBP workstreams from diagnosis through execution, bringing forward recommendations, tradeoffs, and escalation points where needed.
* Lead & improve core HR programs for Engineering & Ops, including performance management, manager effectiveness, talent reviews, engagement planning, and compensation cycles, ensuring they are executed with strategic context and operational rigor.
* Use Rippling, data, and emerging AI-enabled tools thoughtfully to improve insight generation, reduce manual work, and create leverage in recurring people processes.
* Identify patterns and recurring pain points across aligned Engineering & Ops teams, then recommend practical improvements to HR processes, workflows, and manager enablement.
* Partner cross-functionally with HR, Talent, Compensation, Legal, People Ops, HR Systems, and regional HR teams to deliver solutions that support India Engineering & Ops leaders and align with broader HRBP priorities.

**What will you need**

* Minimum of 7+ years of previous HRBP experience & overall HR experience of 10-12 yrs.
* Broad HR expertise across performance management, employee relations, manager effectiveness, organizational design, talent development, and compensation cycles.
* Experience supporting or building people programs, frameworks, processes, or operating rhythms that improve leadership effectiveness, talent outcomes, and organizational health.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect business priorities to practical people strategies, recommendations, and HR solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose organizational health, identify talent risks, and shape recommendations for leaders.
* Ability to operate independently in ambiguous, fast-paced environments, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and knowing when to escalate or align.
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trust, challenge thoughtfully, overcome resistance, and advise leaders through sensitive or complex organizational decisions.
* Experience working in an AI-forward environment, with hands-on experience using AI-enabled tools, workflows, prompts, automations, or skills to increase HRBP leverage, improve manager enablement, and strengthen execution of people programs.

This role anchors PXT support for a set of Corporate Operations teams in India under Udit Madan — one of the most strategically dense Principal HRBP charters in Amazon India. The incumbent partners directly with multiple L8 leaders (tech and non-tech), sets the HR strategy for the combined client group, and operates with the autonomy and influence of a Principal — shaping org design, talent, culture, and workforce transformation rather than executing someone else’s plan. The connective tissue is the common disciplines — org design, span-of-control, leadership depth, talent movement, change leadership — applied to three distinct problems.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Org design & planning: set HR strategy and goals for the client group; lead org design, succession, and change leadership across all three businesses within OP1/OP2/R&O/S-Team goals..
* Talent management: drive forward-looking promotions, succession and top-talent movement incl. L7L8; coach senior business and tech leaders; partner with Comp/Benefits/Stock in a high-mobility market.
* Workforce planning: partner with Finance & Recruiting on OP1/OP2/R&O headcount; set sourcing strategy and strengthen the senior tech/science pipeline.
* Data & culture: use Clarity to diagnose and influence; role-model Leadership Principles and preserve Day-1 culture through scale.
* Function as a coach and consultant to key leaders and their respective organizations; engage in strategic planning meetings to translate business needs into HR plans.
* Review and analyze business metrics including data on retention and employee experience to recommend systemic improvements and drive data-informed decisions.
* Engage COE partners (HR Partner, Talent Management, Organizational Effectiveness, Talent Acquisition, Compensation) to define and tackle organizational obstacles and drive broader PXT initiatives.
* Leverage data, functional expertise, and sound judgment to influence long-term decisions, drive organizational effectiveness, and evolve ways of working across both functions.
* Explore and apply GenAI tools where they add value to HR work, combining AI with human expertise while maintaining transparency, accountability, and sound judgment.

  
About the team  
the Amazon Stores PXT team provides high leverage HRBP support to multiple Stores organization working closely with leaders owning global charters. The HRBPs are at forefront of driving the leadership vision for the teams and driving excellence at the site. They engage across Tech, Business, and Non Tech customer groups working on unique problems to drive higher productivity, better experience, and building strong leadership and culture.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 10+ years of human resources management, or 10+ years of human resources leadership experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of compensation/total rewards, talent management, performance management, compliance, and organization design and development

title: Analyst - Global HR Business Data Steward
description:
Work Your Magic with us!

**HR Business Data Steward:**

**Your Role**

Data is at the heart of every great people decision, and in this role, you will be the guardian of that data. As an HR Business Data Steward, you will ensure the quality, consistency, and integrity of employee data across HR systems and connected downstream applications. You will define data standards, manage data cataloguing and lineage, drive data quality improvements, and act as a trusted partner to data owners, process experts, and business stakeholders. Your work directly enables better workforce insights and more reliable HR operations across the organization.

**Who You Are**

**Education:**

* You bring 2 to 4+ years of experience in data governance, data stewardship, or HR data management, with hands on exposure to HR systems and downstream data consumers.
* You have a solid understanding of data governance concepts, including data quality, metadata, catalogues, lineage, and retention, and are familiar with HR data domains such as employee and organizational data, payroll, compensation, learning, talent acquisition, and skills data.
* You have functional knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central and a strong grasp of HR data operations and processes.
* You are skilled at root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA), with the ability to monitor, measure, and improve data quality metrics such as completeness, accuracy, timeliness, consistency, and integrity.
* You communicate clearly and confidently, translating complex data concepts into plain business language for diverse stakeholders, and facilitating data governance working groups with ease.
* You take a multi system perspective, ensuring data consistency across HR platforms and downstream processes including payroll, benefits, analytics, finance, IT, and ERP or HR information system integrations.
* You hold a degree in Human Resources, Information Management, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience.
* You are AI literate: you understand how artificial intelligence technologies work, can assess their practical applications and limitations in an HR context, and apply ethical considerations around bias, fairness, data privacy, and governance when engaging with AI driven tools and decisions.

**Preferred skills and capabilities**

* **Collaboration**: Strong ability to engage with data owners, domain experts, process leads, and SMEs; effective facilitation and collaboration.
* **Analytical thinking**: Problem-solving mindset with ability to perform root-cause analysis and data quality remediation.
* **Communication**: Clear written and verbal communication; ability to translate data concepts into business terms.
* **Influence and adaptability**: Comfortable driving improvements and adapting to evolving regulatory/business needs.
* **Attention to detail**: Precise in documenting business rules, quality thresholds, and data definitions.
* **Multisystem perspective**: Experience ensuring data consistency across HR systems and downstream processes (e.g., payroll, benefits, analytics, Finance, IT, ERP/HRIS integrations).

**What we offer:** We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

title: Sr Manager - SW Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

The Senior Manager, Software Engineering will lead a software engineering organization responsible for the development and lifecycle management of software used in a high-acuity care environment. This role combines engineering leadership, organizational leadership, operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and AI-enabled transformation.  
  
The successful candidate will be accountable for delivering software that is safe, secure, compliant, maintainable, and aligned with business objectives. The role requires close collaboration with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical, Program Management, and Operations.  
  
In addition, the Senior Manager will lead the adoption of AI-augmented engineering practices across software development, verification, documentation, planning, and operational workflows. The leader will ensure AI is used responsibly, securely, and effectively to improve productivity, quality, decision-making, and delivery performance while maintaining appropriate human oversight, regulatory compliance, and patient safety.  
  
Designs, programs, documents, tests, and fixes bugs involved in creating and maintaining applications and frameworks involved in a software release lifecycle resulting in a digital product. Impacts approaches, projects and programs in the functional area or affected business organization and ways of working. Impacts quality, efficiency and effectiveness of own team. Has significant input into priorities. Guided by professional practices and policies that are shaped by the role. The role has moderate autonomy, requiring high levels of operational judgment.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

  

* Technical & Delivery Leadership
* Own software development execution within the team’s area of responsibility.
* Lead design, development, verification, maintenance, and release activities for regulated software products.
* Drive adoption of modern software engineering practices, including CI/CD, DevOps, test automation, observability, and engineering productivity improvements within the constraints of regulated development environments.
* Establish and monitor engineering metrics related to quality, predictability, productivity, technical debt, and delivery performance.
* Partner with architecture, systems engineering, and product leadership to define technical direction and execution strategy.
* AI-Augmented Engineering Leadership
* Lead the responsible adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices across software development, testing, documentation, planning, and analysis.
* Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, quality, consistency, and decision-making.
* Establish repeatable AI-enabled workflows, templates, prompt libraries, and engineering practices that can be reused across teams.
* Ensure AI-generated outputs are appropriately reviewed, validated, and governed before use in regulated product development activities.
* Promote effective use of approved AI tools while maintaining compliance with company policies, security requirements, intellectual property protections, and regulatory expectations.
* Track and communicate measurable improvements resulting from AI adoption, including cycle time, quality, automation, and engineering efficiency.
* Drive an AI-first mindset while maintaining human accountability for engineering quality, safety, and business outcomes.
* People & Organizational Leadership
* Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing software engineering team.
* Promote psychological safety, diversity, and inclusion within the team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, career development, and performance management; foster a culture of accountability, quality, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with HR and leadership on hiring, workforce planning, succession planning, and organizational development.
* Coach team members and engineering leaders in the effective and responsible use of AI; promote sharing and reuse of successful practices and build capability for AI-augmented engineering.
* Regulatory & Quality Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable medical device software regulations and standards, including IEC 62304, ISO 13485, MDR, and applicable FDA expectations.
* Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to support audits, inspections, and submissions.
* Ensure software lifecycle documentation, including requirements, design, verification, validation, risk management, and traceability, is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.
* Champion a quality-by-design mindset across software teams.
* Ensure AI-enabled practices comply with applicable data privacy, cybersecurity, intellectual property, quality, and regulatory requirements.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work with Program Management to define scope, milestones, risks, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with Product Management and Systems Engineering to align technical execution with customer and business needs.
* Communicate progress, risks, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Support post-market activities, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous product improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in an applicable technical or clinical field, such as Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or Clinical Informatics.
* Minimum 15+ years of experience in the related field
* Demonstrated experience delivering regulated software, preferably for medical devices or other safety-critical systems.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, including Agile, hybrid, or V-model approaches in regulated environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams through complex, multi-release products.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills across functions and leadership levels.
* Demonstrated applied experience using AI in software engineering or product-development workflows and driving responsible adoption within a team.
* Experience validating and governing AI-generated outputs for quality, security, privacy, and compliance.
* Ability to balance innovation, productivity, quality, patient safety, regulatory compliance, cybersecurity, and business objectives.

**Desired Characteristics**

  

* Experience with IEC 62304 software lifecycle processes and FDA/MDR regulatory expectations.
* Familiarity with DevOps, CI/CD, and automated verification in regulated environments.
* Previous participation in regulatory audits, inspections, or submissions.
* Experience establishing reusable AI-enabled engineering practices and measuring their impact on productivity, quality, or delivery performance.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, AI governance, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance considerations.
* Experience coaching teams and leaders in responsible AI adoption.

**Inclusion and Diversity**

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. title: HR assistant/executive for interior fitouts
description:
Job Details

**Job Title:** HR Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Industry:** Wood Industry / Manufacturing  
**Reports To:** HR Manager

**Location:** Factory / Office

2. Job Purpose

To manage day-to-day HR activities, including recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, employee documentation, statutory compliance, employee engagement, and workforce discipline, ensuring smooth HR operations in the wood manufacturing industry.

3. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Recruitment and Selection

* Coordinate recruitment of factory workers, carpenters, machine operators, production staff, engineers, and office employees.
* Source candidates through job portals, consultants, employee referrals, and walk-in interviews.
* Schedule interviews and coordinate with department heads.
* Complete joining formalities, collect documents, and issue appointment letters.
* Maintain recruitment records and manpower requirements.

B. Attendance and Payroll Coordination

* Monitor daily attendance, late coming, absenteeism, overtime, and shift timings.
* Maintain attendance records for factory workers
* Follow up with department heads regarding attendance irregularities.

C.

E. Employee Relations and Discipline

* Address employee queries and workplace concerns.
* Monitor punctuality, discipline, workplace behaviour, and adherence to company policies.
* Issue warning letters and notices as instructed by the HR Manager.
* Coordinate grievance handling and disciplinary proceedings.
* Ensure employees follow company rules, attendance policies, and workplace conduct standards.

F. Training and Employee Engagement

* Coordinate induction and orientation for new employees.
* Organise employee training programmes, safety awareness sessions, and skill development activities.
* Conduct employee engagement activities, celebrations, and recognition programmes.
* Maintain training attendance and feedback records.
* Support employee welfare initiatives and improve employee participation.

G. Factory and Worker HR Management

* Coordinate manpower requirements with Production, Stores, Dispatch, Quality, and other departments.
* Monitor worker attendance, shift allocation, and absenteeism.
* Support onboarding of carpenters, helpers, CNC operators, machine operators, and other factory workers.
* Ensure employees follow factory safety rules, PPE requirements, and housekeeping standards in coordination with the Safety and Production teams. Performance Management
* Follow up with department heads on Workers/employee performance and development.

4. Required Qualifications and Experience

* Graduate in any stream-HRrelated qualification is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in manufacturing or the wood industry.
* Knowledge of recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, and employee documentation.
* Basic understanding of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, Word, email, and HRMS/payroll systems.
* Knowledge of , English, and Hindi is an advantage for communicating with factory workers and staff.

5. Required Skills

* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong coordination and follow-up abilities.
* Problem-solving and grievance-handling skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality.
* Good documentation and record-keeping skills.
* Time management and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage blue-collar employees.
* Professional attitude and fairness in handling employee matters.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of recruitment requirements.
* Accuracy of attendance and payroll (Workers)inputs.
* Timely completion of joining and exit formalities.
* Proper maintenance of employee files and HR records.
* Timely coordination of statutory compliance activities.
* Reduction in absenteeism and late coming through effective follow-up.
* Timely completion of probation reviews and appraisal documentation.
* Completion of employee induction and planned training activities.
* Effective handling of employee grievances and HR queries.

title: Head (Senior Manager) - Industrial Relations
description:
### **About the Team**

You will join the Security & Investigations team within Fulfilment & Experience (F&E) at Meesho. F&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India's cost-efficient, reliable and scalable e-commerce network, serving 100M+ monthly active users. From enabling Valmo's distributed logistics network to building scalable fulfilment and experience platforms, F&E operates at the intersection of technology, operations and network innovation.

Within F&E, the Security & Investigations team safeguards the integrity and resilience of this network. The team investigates shipment loss, pilferage, fraud and misconduct, oversees physical security across operating sites, and coordinates with law enforcement and other stakeholders where required. Working closely with Operations, HR, Legal and logistics partners, the team helps keep the network secure, compliant and resilient.

### **About the Role**

Valmo's operating network is powered by a large and diverse workforce spanning sort centres, hubs and last-mile operations. A significant portion of this workforce is engaged through logistics partners and other workforce arrangements, creating a complex industrial-relations environment across multiple locations and states.

As Head – Industrial Relations, you will own the Industrial Relations (IR) charter for the operating network, within the Security & Investigations function, and work closely with HR, Legal, Operations and partner leadership. Your mandate will be to build a stable, compliant and scalable workforce-relations framework that prevents avoidable disputes, enables fair and timely resolution of workforce issues, and provides strong governance when matters escalate.

The role combines strategic IR leadership with significant field engagement. You will build early-warning mechanisms, manage worker and union relationships, oversee dispute and disciplinary processes, strengthen partner workforce compliance, engage with labour authorities, and create playbooks and governance mechanisms that can scale with the network.

### **What You Will Do**

**Own IR strategy and governance.** Build and continuously evolve a national IR framework covering workforce relations, grievance management, dispute prevention, statutory compliance, worker/union engagement, escalation and resolution.

**Build workforce intelligence and early-warning mechanisms.** Track workforce sentiment, grievances, absenteeism, wage-related concerns, shift and working-condition issues, emerging worker representation or union activity, and other indicators of potential disruption across the network.

**Prevent and manage industrial disputes.** Develop structured approaches to prevent disputes and lead the response to strikes, work stoppages, protests, gheraos and other workforce disruptions. Engage with worker representatives and union leaders and coordinate with Operations, HR, Legal, partners, local administration, labour authorities and law enforcement, as appropriate.

**Bring IR rigour to investigations.** Partner with Security & Investigations, HR and Legal on cases involving employees or partner workers, including theft, fraud, misconduct and policy violations. Ensure due process, appropriate documentation and legally sound decision-making.

**Govern disciplinary processes.** Oversee show-cause notices, domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions, ensuring that processes are fair, consistent, timely and legally defensible under applicable law, standing orders and organisational policy.

**Drive partner workforce compliance.** Establish and monitor governance over logistics partners covering contract labour requirements, wage and benefits compliance, statutory registrations, working hours, worker documentation, grievance mechanisms and other applicable labour requirements. Drive timely corrective action and escalation where gaps are identified.

**Own government and authority engagement.** Build effective working relationships with labour departments, labour commissioners, conciliation officers and other relevant government authorities. Represent the organisation in inspections, conciliation proceedings and hearings, in partnership with Legal, and coordinate with Security on matters requiring law-enforcement engagement.

**Build effective grievance and escalation channels.** Design and strengthen mechanisms such as worker helplines, site-level committees, grievance forums and escalation paths so that workforce concerns are surfaced and resolved before they become formal disputes.

**Create scalable IR playbooks and capability.** Develop SOPs, policies, escalation matrices and response playbooks for dispute management, investigation-linked disciplinary action, partner workforce issues and authority engagement. Train site leaders, partner supervisors, HR teams and security personnel on relevant IR practices and labour-law basics.

**Build IR analytics and leadership reporting.** Establish dashboards and regular reviews covering incidents, disputes, grievances, compliance health, partner risks, resolution timelines, repeat issues and emerging trends. Translate these into clear insights and actions for senior leadership.

**Strengthen cross-functional governance.** Establish clear interfaces between IR, HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and partner leadership, including decision rights, escalation threshold

### **What You Will Need**

* 8–15 years of experience in industrial relations, employee relations, labour relations or labour-law compliance, preferably in large, distributed workforce environments.
* Experience in logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, infrastructure or other large blue-collar and/or contract-workforce environments is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including the Labour Codes and associated rules/notifications, contract labour requirements, industrial disputes, standing orders and relevant state-specific requirements.
* Practical experience applying labour law and IR principles on the ground across multiple sites and, ideally, multiple states.
* Proven experience handling industrial disputes, worker grievances, union/worker representative engagement, negotiations, strikes or work stoppages.
* Experience conducting or overseeing domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings, with a strong understanding of how employee investigations intersect with employment law and due process.
* Experience managing contract labour or partner workforce compliance, including audits, statutory requirements, wage-related compliance and remediation.
* Strong ability to engage with labour authorities, conciliation officers and other government stakeholders, preferably with experience representing an organisation in formal proceedings.
* Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm, credible and objective in high-pressure situations.
* Ability to work effectively across HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and external partners, with sound judgement on ownership, escalation and confidentiality.
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in one or more regional languages is an advantage, particularly for workforce-heavy operating regions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including the ability to use workforce and incident data to identify patterns, risks and preventive actions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across operating locations and respond to sensitive on-ground situations at short notice.
* High integrity, discretion and maturity, with the ability to handle confidential matters and decisions that can materially affect employees and workers.
* A degree in law, HR, labour welfare, social work or a related discipline (LLB, MSW, MBA-HR or equivalent) is preferred.

**Role Characteristics**

* National scope with significant field engagement across the operating network.
* High level of cross-functional and external stakeholder interaction.
* Combination of strategic programme ownership, operational problem-solving and on-ground dispute management.
* Requires sound judgement, neutrality, confidentiality and the ability to balance business continuity with fair and compliant workforce practices.

title: Senior HRIS Admin (Workday Benefits & Absences)
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

**SUMMARY**  
Q2 is seeking an HRIS Administrator to serve as a functional and technical subject-matter expert for the Benefits and Absence modules within our Workday HCM platform. In this role you will own the day-to-day configuration, administration, and integrity of these modules while partnering closely with Total Rewards, Benefits, and Leave Administration leadership to deliver a seamless employee experience. This role works as a paired backup with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator, so experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking is a plus. You bring proven Workday hands-on expertise and are motivated to drive continuous improvement across the HR technology landscape.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Analysis, Configuration & Technical Excellence**

* Maintain and administer Workday Benefits and Absence modules, including benefit plans, eligibility rules, open enrollment and life event configuration, leave plans, and accrual rules; serve as the primary functional and technical expert for these domains.
* Design and configure multi-step business processes, and lead end-to-end testing cycles for annual open enrollment, plan year changes, and leave policy updates, confirming downstream impacts with stakeholders.
* Troubleshoot and resolve Workday configuration, calculation, and reporting issues by designing durable fixes and evaluating cross-system impacts using systems thinking.
* Provide backup support for Payroll and Time Tracking module administration, partnering with the Payroll and Time Tracking Administrator to ensure continuity of coverage.

**Data Integrity & Quality**

* Ensure data accuracy and system integrity across Benefits and Absence, including enrollment audits, deduction reconciliation with Payroll, and carrier and vendor eligibility reconciliation; lead audit data work and implement data quality improvements.
* Write, maintain, and support standard and custom Workday reports and dashboards; ensure system outputs comply with controls and proactively surface insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration workbooks, test results, and help guides across all assigned modules.

**Integrations & Vendor Partnership**

* Support and monitor benefits carrier and vendor integrations (such as medical, dental, vision, 401(k), HSA/FSA, and leave management vendors); resolve file errors, eligibility discrepancies, and enrollment mismatches.
* Partner with benefits brokers, carriers, and third-party administrators on annual plan changes, regulatory updates, and data feed requirements.

**Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Review, assess, and recommend improvements to HRIS workflows, user experience, and system processes; design scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and drive operational efficiency.
* Design and implement multi-step automations that streamline HR workflows; integrate AI-enabled tools to improve accuracy and delivery speed.
* Develop and maintain end-user procedures, guidelines, training materials, and documentation; own training design and delivery for open enrollment, system updates, and platform change readiness.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Customer Partnership**

* Lead requirements definition and solution validation with HR, Benefits, Leave Administration, Payroll, and business stakeholders; serve as a trusted advisor recommending system improvements grounded in user feedback and business needs.
* Lead project workstreams for Workday module implementations and enhancements, aligning system decisions to project goals and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Facilitate strong business partnerships with internal stakeholders, keeping all relevant parties informed, enabling meaningful feedback loops, and representing the HR Technology team with excellence.

**EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in Human Resources, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5+ years of HRIS experience with a strong focus on Workday Benefits and Absence module configuration and administration.
* Strong understanding of HCM design, structure, functions, and processes, including business process workflows, advanced reporting capabilities, and overall system compliance.
* Working knowledge of the following HR business domains: Benefits Administration and Absence/Leave Management, including applicable regulations (such as ACA, ERISA, COBRA, FMLA, and state and local leave laws).
* Organized, detail-oriented, and effective communicator capable of translating complex technical configurations into clear guidance for HR and business stakeholders.
* Self-starter with a strong desire to seek optimal solutions, share discoveries with colleagues, and drive exceptional results.
* Excellent customer service skills and enthusiasm for developing strong partnerships with internal users and leadership.
* Experience with management of SOX/internal compliance audits preferred.
* Experience with Workday Payroll and Time Tracking modules is a plus, as this role will provide backup support for those functions.
* Experience supporting global Benefits and Absence programs across multiple countries and diverse employee populations preferred.
* Experience working on HRIS or HR Operations teams in a global company, including supporting system configuration and end-user training across geographies preferred.
* Familiarity with HR technology integrations, including benefits carrier feeds, payroll, leave vendors, and third-party systems preferred.

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

**Health & Wellness**

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents

**SUMMARY**  
Q2 is seeking an HR Administrator to serve as a functional and technical subject-matter expert for the Payroll and Time Tracking modules within our Workday HCM platform. In this role you will own the day-to-day configuration, administration, and integrity of these modules while partnering closely with Payroll, Finance, and Total Rewards leadership to deliver accurate and timely pay for our employees. This role works as a paired backup with the Benefits and Absence Management Administrator, so experience with Workday Benefits and Absence is a plus. You bring proven Workday hands-on expertise and are motivated to drive continuous improvement across the HR technology landscape.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Systems Analysis, Configuration & Technical Excellence**

* Maintain and administer Workday Payroll and Time Tracking modules, including pay calculations, earnings and deductions, time entry and time off configuration, work schedules, and overtime rules; serve as the primary functional and technical expert for these domains.

* Write, maintain, and support standard and custom Workday reports and dashboards; ensure system outputs comply with controls and proactively surface insights to stakeholders.
* Maintain comprehensive system documentation, including configuration workbooks, test results, and help guides across all assigned modules.

**Integrations & Vendor Partnership**

* Support and monitor payroll, tax, general ledger, and time clock integrations; resolve file errors, calculation variances, and data transfer issues.
* Partner with payroll vendors, tax providers, and Finance on regulatory updates, payroll cutoffs, and data feed requirements.

**Process Optimization, Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Review, assess, and recommend improvements to HRIS workflows, user experience, and system processes; design scalable solutions that reduce manual effort and drive operational efficiency.

* Lead project workstreams for Workday module implementations and enhancements, aligning system decisions to project goals and driving cross-functional alignment.
* Facilitate strong business partnerships with internal stakeholders, keeping all relevant parties informed, enabling meaningful feedback loops, and representing the HR Technology team with excellence.

**EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of experience in Human Resources, Information Systems, Accounting, or a related field.
* 5+ years of HRIS experience with a strong focus on Workday Payroll and Time Tracking module configuration and administration.
* Strong understanding of HCM design, structure, functions, and processes, including business process workflows, advanced reporting capabilities, and overall system compliance.
* Working knowledge of the following HR business domains: Payroll and Time Tracking, including wage and hour regulations (such as FLSA and state and local requirements) and payroll tax concepts.
* Organized, detail-oriented, and effective communicator capable of translating complex technical configurations into clear guidance for HR and business stakeholders.

title: Recruitment Business Partner
description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are looking for a Recruitment Business Partner to lead recruitment delivery for a portfolio of client accounts from our India delivery centre. You will lead a team of team leads and recruiters, partner with Sales and client hiring managers, and own the full hiring cycle from requirement to joining.

This is a delivery leadership role, not a desk-recruiting role. You will be measured on outcomes: how quickly strong candidates reach the client, how many are selected, and how many join. You will also act as a trusted advisor to Sales and clients, using market insight and data to shape realistic requirements, rates and timelines.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Delivery ownership**

* Own monthly and quarterly hiring targets (selections and joiners) for the accounts in scope.
* Prioritise open requirements each week, and decide which to push, escalate or pause.
* Make sure quality profiles reach the client quickly, especially on priority roles.
* Track every requirement from intake to joining, and step in early when a role stalls, a candidate disengages or an offer is at risk.

**Stakeholder management**

* Lead intake and calibration discussions so every role has a clear brief, a realistic budget and an agreed interview process before sourcing starts.
* Agree feedback timelines with Sales and clients, and follow up with data when they slip.
* Advise Sales on which requirements are likely to close and where the team should focus.

**People leadership**

* Lead, coach and manage team leads and recruiters against clear weekly productivity goals.
* Run regular performance reviews, identify gaps early and put development plans in place.
* Hire, onboard and ramp up new recruiters, and develop future team leads.

**Process and data**

* Make sure the team follows the agreed recruitment process, with accurate and complete data in the applicant tracking system.
* Use dashboards and reports to find bottlenecks across the hiring funnel (submission interview selection joining) and fix them.
* Keep offer and post-selection drop-outs low, and lead root-cause reviews when they rise.

**Quality and candidate experience**

* Raise screening quality so clients see fewer, better-matched profiles.
* Make sure every candidate receives timely updates and a clear outcome.

**Sourcing channels**

* Work closely with the central sourcing team on role allocation, handovers and turnaround time.
* Make effective use of job boards, referrals, vendor partners and internal talent pools.

**Reporting**

* Prepare monthly account and team performance reviews for leadership, with clear commentary on trends and actions.

**How success is measured**
---------------------------

* Selections and joiners against target
* Time to first qualified profiles on priority roles
* Submission-to-interview and interview-to-selection conversion
* Offer and post-selection drop-out rates
* Joiner retention in the first 30 days
* Team productivity and data quality
* Stakeholder satisfaction (Sales and client feedback)

**What you bring**
------------------

**Must have**

* 8–12 years in recruitment, with at least 3 years leading recruiters or team leads against delivery targets.
* A strong background in IT recruitment or staffing (contract, permanent or managed services), ideally for international clients.
* A proven record of meeting hiring targets, which you can back with your own numbers.
* Confidence with senior stakeholders: you run intake calls, challenge with evidence and handle escalations calmly.
* Strong analytical skills: comfortable with funnel metrics, Excel and BI dashboards.
* A coaching leadership style that balances accountability with development.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Global Capability Centres (GCC), offshore or captive delivery models.
* Experience working with European clients and across time zones.
* Experience integrating teams after a merger or acquisition.
* Experience managing recruitment vendors.
* Hands-on experience with ATS and CRM tools.

**What we offer**
-----------------

* A visible leadership role in a growing India delivery centre serving international clients.
* Ownership of client accounts and a team, with the scope to shape how delivery runs.
* Quarterly performance incentive linked to hiring outcomes.
* A central sourcing team, shared dashboards and a well-defined recruitment process to support you.
* Clear growth path into wider account or regional leadership.

title: Workday Analyst
description:

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

  

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

Solventum is seeking a highly motivated **Workday Analyst** to join our team and provide ongoing support for various Workday modules, including **HCM Core, Recruiting and Compensation** . The Workday Analyst will support 2 to 3 of the above modules and work closely with the US-based team to drive system initiatives, deliver improvements, and provide day-to-day support for Workday-related activities.

In this role, the analyst will be responsible for managing support tickets, resolving issues, assisting with system configurations, performing testing, and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure the optimal use of Workday functionality. The ideal candidate will have a solid understanding of Workday, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to work across time zones with the US team.

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**

  

* **Workday Recruiting:**
  + Serve as the first point of contact for the US-based team, addressing Workday-related support tickets and providing timely resolutions for any system issues.
  + Configure and maintain Workday Recruiting processes such as job requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview scheduling, offer management and Onboarding
  + Strong experience resolving configuration and functional issues across recruiting and onboarding modules, as well as touchpoints with other modules.
  + Collaborate with HR and Talent Acquisition teams to optimize recruiting workflows
  + Ensure the integrity of data across modules by monitoring system performance, investigating discrepancies, and implementing solutions.
  + Document and track issues, solutions, and improvements to provide a knowledge base for future support.
  Strong expertise in designing complex Workday calculated fields, with a solid understanding of business objects, data sources, and the appropriate placement of calculations.

  

* **Workday Compensation:**
  + Configure and maintain compensation plans, packages, eligibility rules, compensation grades and grade profiles, compensation basis and related reference data.
  + Support compensation transactions within staffing and worker lifecycle processes, including hire, change job, promotion and compensation change events.
  + Analyze compensation configuration issues, eligibility outcomes and process routing; recommend corrective actions and sustainable design improvements.
  + Collaborate with Compensation, HR and Payroll stakeholders to validate requirements, assess downstream impacts and support accurate, controlled deployment.
  Support the execution of global compensation processes, including Annual Review Process, AIP and other compensation initiatives, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

  

* **Collaboration with US-Based Team:**
  + Work closely with the US-based Workday team to understand business requirements, provide technical expertise, and ensure system configurations are aligned with organizational goals.
  + Assist in the implementation and execution of new features, functionality, and module upgrades by following established processes.
  Participate in cross-team meetings with the US team to align on priorities, project timelines, and best practices.

  

* **Workday Configuration & System Maintenance:**
  + Assist with the configuration and maintenance of Workday HCM, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, and Reporting modules based on business needs.
  + Support system updates, testing, and deployment activities to ensure smooth transitions during Workday upgrades or new releases.
  Ensure that workflows, business processes, and security roles are accurately configured to meet the needs of the business.

  

* **Project Support & Initiative Execution:**
  + Collaborate with the US-based team to drive global initiatives and provide support for ongoing projects, including process improvements and system enhancements.
  + Participate in system testing for new releases, changes, and enhancements, ensuring that all configurations meet business requirements.
  Assist with documenting project requirements, processes, and procedures to ensure proper system utilization.

  

* **Reporting & Data Analysis:**
  + Develop and maintain Workday reports and dashboards to support HR, payroll, and business requirements.
  + Assist with extracting, validating, and analyzing data to support business decision-making and compliance requirements.
  Collaborate with the reporting team to create custom reports or modify existing ones based on user feedback.

  

* **Training & Knowledge Sharing:**
  + Provide training and guidance to HR and business teams on Workday best practices, system functionality, and process improvements.
  Maintain up-to-date documentation on configurations, processes, and system changes to facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.

  

* **Continuous Improvement:**
  + Identify opportunities for process improvement and suggest enhancements to increase system efficiency and user satisfaction.
  Proactively address potential issues by analyzing trends, preparing solutions, and collaborating with the US team to resolve them.

  

**Your Skills and Expertise**

  

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

  

* **Experience:** 5+ years of experience in Workday support or HRIS roles with exposure to multiple Workday modules.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in human resources, IT, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Workday Expertise:** Solid experience supporting multiple Workday modules (HCM Core, Compensation, Recruiting, Talent, Reporting).
* **Analytical Skills:** Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify system issues, resolve problems, and offer solutions.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Proficient in Workday’s reporting tools, Calc Fields, security configuration, and business process configuration.
* **Communication Skills:** Excellent communication skills (verbal and written) with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams across different time zones.
* **Problem-Solving:** Strong problem-solving abilities to address support tickets, improve system functionality, and handle system issues efficiently.
* **Project Management:** Experience supporting system upgrades, new functionality, and process improvements.

  

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Workday Certifications:** Workday certifications in relevant modules (e.g., Workday HCM Core, Workday Compensation, Workday Recruiting) are highly desirable.
* **Global Workday Experience:** Experience in supporting global Workday implementations or managing cross-country configurations.
* **Reporting Expertise:** Strong experience in creating and maintaining custom reports and dashboards in Workday.

title: Lead Specialist, HR Operations
description:
**Job Title:** Lead Specialist, HR Operations

**Description:** This role aligns with industry titles such as Vendor Management Systems (VMS) Program Manager, MSP Program Manager, VMS product Manager or Beeline VMS Administrator

**The Role**

We are the HR Product Owner team. We decide what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, in what order, and why. The HR community brings us their problems and their ideas, and we make sure they get into the system, get prioritised, and get tested before they reach anyone. Our colleagues never need to go to the technology teams directly. That is our job.

Each of us owns a domain end to end: onboarding and offboarding journeys, leave and absence, talent management, benefits and vendor management. This role adds the one domain we are missing.

As Program Manager and PO for Contingent Workforce, you will own the contingent worker journey as a product, from the moment someone is sourced, through onboarding, extensions and role changes, to the day they leave and their access is closed cleanly. Hire to retire, with one owner.

Today that journey runs across a vendor management system, Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and our identity platforms, with different teams owning different pieces and nobody holding the whole thread. A working prototype already exists: a single conversational front door where a hiring manager gives the information once and the systems do the rest, with no tickets raised at all. Your job is to take that from a promising prototype to a permanent service, and to extend it across the full lifecycle.

This is not a role about keeping a system running. You will bring a process architect mindset to simplify genuine complexity, working with shared services, global HR systems and emerging technologies such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence, so that the contingent worker experience becomes something we design rather than something that happens.

**What You'll Own**

Own the contingent worker journey end to end as a product, with a clear roadmap, prioritised increments and measurable outcomes.

Act as business owner of our vendor management system (Beeline), covering configuration, supplier onboarding, rate card structures, worker classification and reporting.

Manage the relationship with the vendor management system provider and with staffing suppliers, holding both to agreed service levels.

Map the journey across Talent Acquisition, Procurement, Finance, IT, Security, and the country teams, then redesign it rather than simply document it.

Identify where policy rather than technology is the real blocker, and build the case to change it.

Maintain the role-based profile model so that access and equipment are provisioned automatically for standard roles, and manually only for genuine exceptions.

Translate what you learn into what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, and see it through to testing and adoption.

Work alongside the Global Process Owner for Hire-to-Onboard, and with the teams building provisioning for permanent employees, so we converge on one pattern rather than several.

Bring security, compliance and audit in early, not at the point of go-live.

Define and track what good looks like: time from source to day one, day one readiness, tickets raised per worker, and satisfaction of both the worker and the hiring manager.

**About You**

Five to eight years of experience in contingent workforce programmes, managed service provider models, or HR operations with direct contingent workforce responsibility.

Hands-on ownership of a vendor management system such as Beeline or SAP Fieldglass, including configuration, supplier management and reporting. Experience as an end user alone is not enough for this role.

A process architect mindset: you can map a cross-functional journey, find where the time and the friction actually sit, and simplify it.

Comfort with data. You build the measurement case yourself rather than waiting for a report.

Proven success working in a matrix environment, influencing across functions without direct authority.

Curiosity and openness to innovation, including robotic process automation, artificial intelligence and agent-based workflows.

Clear written communication. Much of this role is making a complex journey understandable to people who own only one part of it.

Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra is an advantage.

Understanding of contingent worker classification and compliance requirements across multiple countries is an advantage.

**What You'll Get**

You will own a journey that thousands of people at Pearson experience, and you will own it properly: the system, the process, the suppliers and the roadmap. Few roles at this level give you that much of a canvas.

You will also arrive at the right moment. The problem is already evidenced, a prototype already works, and there is executive attention on the outcome. What is missing is a single owner to turn it into something permanent and scale it.

As the world's leading learning company, Pearson is transforming how people learn, work and grow. You will be based in India and working globally, with hybrid and flexible working, and with a team of product owners around you who are solving the same kind of problem in their own domains.

**Ready to make an Impact?**

Apply now and help shape what’s next.

**Who we are:**

At Pearson, our purpose is simple: to help people realize the life they imagine through learning. We believe that every learning opportunity is a chance for a personal breakthrough. We are the world's lifelong learning company. For us, learning isn't just what we do. It's who we are. To learn more: We are Pearson.

Pearson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a member of E-Verify. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status or any other group protected by law. We actively seek qualified candidates who are protected veterans and individuals with disabilities as defined under VEVRAA and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act.

If you are an individual with a disability and are unable or limited in your ability to use or access our career site as a result of your disability, you may request reasonable accommodations by emailing TalentExperienceGlobalTeam@grp.pearson.com.

title: HR - Business Admin
description:
**About Signeasy**

Contracts run businesses. We're unlocking the intelligence inside them.

Signeasy began 16 years ago with a simple idea: signing should be easy. That idea helped the world go paperless. But signatures were only the beginning.

Today, the real problem isn't signing contracts. It's what happens after. In most companies, contracts sit scattered across inboxes, shared drives, CLMs, ERPs, and filing systems. They're static, forgotten, and underused, yet they quietly define revenue, risk, compliance, and growth. We believe contracts are one of the most powerful and most overlooked sources of truth in a business.

2025 changed everything. While others continued to treat contracts as paperwork, we began turning them into living, searchable, and intelligent systems of record. We shipped more than 250 product releases, achieved 21 CFR Part 11 compliance, and were featured at Apple's WWDC, all while building the foundation for what comes next.

2026 is our biggest year yet. With the launch of Intelligent Contract Management, we're going to market with an AI-powered contract management platform built for modern teams who expect more than storage, signatures, or status quo software.

This is the moment, and this is the team building it. If you want to help shape the future of contracts with us, read on.

  

**Your role**

As our Business Admin, you'll be part of the People team and the operational backbone of Signeasy. You'll own the employee experience from offer acceptance to exit, work directly with our C-suite on their calendars and travel, keep our workplace and tools running well, and support our Finance team as the role grows. This is a 1-year, full-time contract position.

It's a broad role with plenty of variety. On any given day, you might be getting a new joiner ready for Day 1, planning an executive's trip to Dallas, and closing out a laptop return. You'll bring structure to all of it, and you'll use AI to work faster and smarter along the way.

If you enjoy being the person others rely on to get things done, and you'd like visibility across the whole business, you'll find a lot to love here.

  

**What you'll do**

People operations

* Manage employee records, documentation, and HRIS data so they're always accurate and current and maintain HR trackers and reports
* Act as the first point of contact for employee questions on HR processes, policies, and tools
* Plan and coordinate engagement activities, celebrations, and internal events

Onboarding and offboarding

* Own onboarding and offboarding end to end, tracking every step to completion - Coordinate pre-joining logistics: offer documentation, swag, laptop setup, and Day 1 readiness
* Grant and revoke access to tools and systems, making sure each person has only the access their role requires
* Run structured exits: laptop recovery, access removal, and clean handovers
* Maintain a single source of truth for every joiner and exit

C-suite support

* Manage calendars for our C-suite executives, including scheduling, rescheduling, and prioritizing meetings
* Plan and book domestic and international travel end to end: flights, hotels, visas, local transport, and itineraries
* Plan and coordinate meetings and offsites for the C-suite, from scheduling and venues to on-the-day logistics
* Handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment

Workplace and admin operations

* Keep the office well managed, well stocked, and organized
* Coordinate with vendors on supplies, equipment, and services
* Prepare the work-from-office analysis report in partnership with our workspace vendor

Laptops and tools

* Manage the laptop lifecycle: forecasting needs, procurement, allocation, servicing, and recovery
* Maintain the laptop asset sheet as the master record: device, serial number, owner, condition, and status
* Support device enrollment and compliance through Kandji
* Administer everyday tools like Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, and Zoom, and keep track of licenses and accessories

Finance support

* Support the Finance team with documentation, records, and routine admin tasks as you settle in
* No prior finance experience is required. You'll learn on the job.

AI and automation

* Use AI tools for drafting, summarizing, data cleanup, and reporting
* Build simple automations and templates that reduce manual, repetitive work
* Keep improving our trackers and workflows so they're smarter, not busier
  

**Who you are**

We're looking for someone structured, detail-oriented, and people-first: a dependable operator who takes ownership and keeps things moving.

* 2 to 3 years of experience in HR operations, business administration, or executive support (a blend is ideal)
* Excellent organization and documentation skills, with a track record of keeping trackers and calendars accurate
* Hands-on experience with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft 365
* A basic understanding of access management and device setup
* Comfort using AI tools to work more efficiently
* Discretion and sound judgment with confidential information
* Strong written and spoken English, schooled in an English-medium institution, with a clear, service-minded communication style
* Self-driven, reliable, and calm under pressure, with the ability to manage multiple priorities

  

**Why you'll love this role**

This role gives you a rare view of the whole company. You'll work closely with our C-suite, partner with every team, and see firsthand how HR, operations, and finance come together as we scale.

Your work will directly shape the employee experience at Signeasy: how smoothly people join, how reliably their tools work, and how efficiently the business runs day to day. That's what lets our product, engineering, and sales teams stay focused on building the future of contracts.

It's a high-trust role with real ownership and clear room to grow, starting in HR and admin and expanding into broader operations over time.

  

**Why work with Signeasy**

Our values make us a TIGER: Trust, Integrity, Growth mindset, Empathy, and Responsibility.

We're a lean, close-knit, and nimble team. We're opinionated but collaborative: we disagree, then commit to a shared decision. We're modern, but we don't follow trends blindly. We're easy to work with, and we believe in having difficult conversations. We ask lots of questions, experiment, and learn fast. And we're deeply empathetic toward our customers, our colleagues, and ourselves.

Our people are our greatest asset. You'll work alongside some of the smartest, most humble people around the world, who come from diverse backgrounds and bring a wide range of experiences. We're a hybrid-friendly organization that values flexibility, with a mix of in-person collaboration at the office and focused work from home.

We are the #SigneasyTribe. Ask us plenty of questions about our culture, so we can both see whether there's a real connection that makes this a great experience for both of us.

**We'd love to hear from you**

Great talent comes from all kinds of paths. If this role speaks to you, please apply, even if you don't match every line on paper. We review every application and will get back to you within a week.

* Hear what it's like to work at Signeasy
* Meet Signeasy's leadership team
* Read our origin story
* Take a peek at Signeasy's culture
* Learn more about growth at Signeasy

Signeasy is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Principal Engineer -Data Engineering
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.

The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* 7+ years of progressive engineering experience with sustained hands‑on expertise in architecture, system design, and end‑to‑end solution development.
* 7+ years of Data Engineering experience, with strong expertise in driving migration from legacy data platforms to cloud‑native, lakehouse‑based architectures
* 3+ Years of Hands-on experience in transformation of legacy data framework to modern stack in private or public cloud.
* Architect and implement modern data platforms using Azure Fabric (OneLake, Data Factory, Synapse, Real‑Time Analytics, Power BI integration).
* Design and build data pipelines and platforms on GCP using services such as : BigQuery, Dataflow/Apache Beam, Pub/Sub, Dataproc/Spark, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Dataplex, Data Catalog

* Deep expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Beam)
* Strong hands‑on background of developing large scale enterprise applications.

* Experience with data modeling, ETL/ELT patterns, and Lakehouse architecture.
* Hands on experience in building modernized applications using Microservice architecture.
* Cloud-native engineering experience — serverless, managed Spark, event-driven architectures.
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, K8s) and workflow operators.
* Knowledge of data governance platforms (Collibra, Alation, Purview).
* Experience implementing lineage, observability, drift detection.

* Drive innovation by introducing emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to improve decision‑making, automation, and predictive insights.
* Strong background in AI, Machine Learning, GenAI, including retrieval systems, embeddings, chunking strategies, and agentic AI workflows.

**Job Expectations:**

* Enterprise Technical Stewardship
  + Act as a Principal Engineer and strategic advisor to senior leadership, shaping technology decisions that impact multiple lines of business and the broader enterprise.
  + Define and evolve enterprise‑scale architectures for Data modernization ensuring alignment with security, risk, and regulatory requirements.
* Hands‑On Leadership
  + Remain deeply hands‑on—designing, reviewing, and occasionally coding critical components to set a high engineering bar.
  + Lead by example in applying engineering rigor, automation, testing, performance optimization, and secure coding practices.
* Influence & Thought Leadership
  + Serve as a visible technical spokesperson internally and externally, presenting ideas, architectures, and innovation narratives with clarity and conviction.
  + Mentor senior engineers and architects, raising the overall technical maturity of the organization.
  + Foster a culture of engineering excellence, curiosity, and continuous learning.
* Outside‑In Innovation
  + Continuously scan the external ecosystem to bring new ideas, technologies, and patterns into the enterprise in a pragmatic, value‑driven manner.
  + Challenge legacy thinking and advocate for simplification, modernization, and platform thinking.
  + Balance innovation with operational stability, risk management, and long‑term sustainability.
* Data Engineering
  + Responsible for designing, developing, optimizing, and maintaining metadata‑driven, scalable, high‑performance data engineering frameworks that power critical data ecosystem in the HR space.
  + Define and execute the enterprise data engineering roadmap aligned to business priorities.
  + Mentor data engineering teams delivering scalable, secure, and high quality data solutions.
  + Partner with architecture, product, analytics, and risk teams to drive data driven decision making.
  + Track industry trends, evaluate relevant tools/platforms, and adapt the best practices,

* AI / GenAI Enablement
  + Drive the strategy, adoption, and governance of AI and GenAI capabilities across HR initiatives.
  + Partner with product, data, risk, and security teams to ensure responsible, explainable, and scalable AI solutions.
  + Identify high‑value use cases and guide teams from proof‑of‑concept to production at scale.
* Outcome‑Driven Execution
  + Measure success through business impact, not just technical delivery—improved time‑to‑market, developer productivity, system resilience, and customer outcomes.
  + Partner closely with stakeholders to ensure technology investments deliver durable, enterprise‑wide value.
