description:
Role Description:

About the role
--------------

We are looking for a highly organized and service-oriented Recruiting Coordinator to support a seamless candidate and stakeholder experience across the hiring lifecycle. This role combines hands-on recruiting coordination with Talent Acquisition operations, making it ideal for someone who enjoys both the people-facing and process-focused sides of recruiting.

You will partner closely with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, HR partners, and other cross-functional teams to keep hiring processes moving efficiently. You will also help maintain accurate recruiting data, improve operational workflows, and identify opportunities to make our recruiting programs more scalable and consistent.

What you’ll do
--------------

### Recruiting coordination

* Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, calendars, interview formats, and stakeholder groups.
* Own the interview scheduling process from intake through completion, including rescheduling and last-minute changes.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for candidates, providing timely updates and a high-quality candidate experience.
* Prepare interview plans, agendas, briefing materials, and interviewer guidance.
* Coordinate candidate travel, virtual interview logistics, assessments, and other pre-employment activities where required.
* Ensure interview feedback is collected promptly and follow up with interviewers and hiring teams as needed.
* Support offer coordination, pre-boarding activities, and handoffs to HR or onboarding teams.
* Maintain clear, professional, and inclusive communication with candidates and internal stakeholders.

### Talent Acquisition operations

* Maintain accurate and timely candidate, requisition, interview, and disposition data in the applicant tracking system.
* Complete regular data-quality checks and resolve discrepancies in partnership with recruiters and HR stakeholders.
* Prepare recruiting reports, dashboards, and operational updates covering pipeline health, interview activity, aging, and process performance.
* Support requisition creation, approvals, status changes, and closure activities in line with established processes.
* Document recruiting workflows, standard operating procedures, templates, and service-level expectations.
* Coordinate with background-check, assessment, travel, and other recruiting vendors as applicable.
* Support vendor administration, invoice tracking, purchase orders, and related operational activities.
* Contribute to recruiting projects such as ATS enhancements, process audits, reporting improvements, employer branding initiatives, and recruitment campaigns.
* Identify recurring process issues and recommend practical improvements that increase efficiency and improve the candidate or stakeholder experience.
* Help ensure recruiting processes are applied consistently and in accordance with company policies and applicable requirements.

What we’re looking for
----------------------

* 3–6 years of experience in recruiting coordination, Talent Acquisition operations, HR operations, or a related role.
* Experience coordinating interviews and managing multiple recruiting workflows simultaneously.
* Strong working knowledge of applicant tracking systems and recruiting tools.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain accurate data and produce clear operational reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a professional and candidate-friendly approach.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, especially when managing changing priorities and complex calendars.
* Ability to work effectively with recruiters, hiring managers, interviewers, candidates, and cross-functional partners.
* Comfort working with spreadsheets, reporting tools, and structured data.
* Sound judgment when handling confidential candidate and employee information.
* Ability to work independently while escalating risks, delays, and exceptions appropriately.

Preferred qualifications
------------------------

* Experience supporting recruiting across multiple business functions, geographies, or high-volume hiring programs.
* Experience with ATS reporting, recruiting dashboards, or process documentation.
* Exposure to recruiting technology implementations, workflow automation, or continuous-improvement projects.
* Experience working with recruiting vendors, background-check providers, assessment platforms, or travel partners.
* Familiarity with inclusive hiring practices and data privacy expectations.

Success in this role
--------------------

In the first 6–12 months, success will look like:

  

* Interviews are scheduled accurately and efficiently, with minimal avoidable changes or delays.
* Candidates and hiring teams receive timely, clear, and consistent communication.
* ATS records, interview feedback, and requisition data are accurate and up to date.
* Recruiting reports and dashboards are reliable, actionable, and delivered on time.
* Core recruiting processes are documented and followed consistently.
* Operational improvements reduce manual effort and improve the experience for candidates and hiring teams.

Core competencies
-----------------

* Candidate and stakeholder focus
* Planning and prioritization
* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow-through
* Data accuracy and operational discipline
* Process improvement mindset
* Collaboration and communication
* Confidentiality and sound judgment

Why this role matters
---------------------

This role sits at the center of the recruiting experience. By combining excellent coordination with strong operational discipline, you will help recruiters and hiring managers move faster, help candidates feel informed and supported, and strengthen the systems and processes that enable our Talent Acquisition team to scale.

title: HR Workday Security Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission\-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.  



  

**The Role**

**HR Workday Security Specialist**

At Kyndryl, this role provides strategic leadership and governance oversight for Workday and the broader HR ecosystem, ensuring robust HR data protection and that security policies, access models, and controls are consistently defined, implemented by partners, and audited across the global enterprise.


While the role does not perform direct Workday security configuration, it requires deep knowledge of Workday security architecture and configuration to guide design, assess risk, and validate control effectiveness. Instead, it serves as the functional security authority, partnering closely with CIO, HR Technology, IAM, and Compliance teams to define requirements, review designs, validate implementation, and ensure audit‑ready controls are in place.


**Key Responsibilities**

Workday Security Strategy \& Governance


* Define and maintain Workday security strategy, principles, and access models, aligned with Kyndryl security standards and regulatory requirements.
* Establish role‑based access and data protection policies governing how Workday security should be configured and managed.
* Act as the Workday security subject‑matter expert, providing guidance on domains, business process security, security groups, and sensitive data access from a governance perspective.
* Review and approve Workday security designs and changes proposed by CIO / HR COE teams to ensure alignment with policy and risk expectations.

Security Policy, Standards \& Control Design


* Develop and operationalize HR security policies and standards covering Workday and HR‑related systems, including downstream data consumers.
* Define control requirements for Workday security, access provisioning, approvals, and monitoring.
* Ensure Workday security controls are consistently applied across regions and business units.

Audit, Risk \& Compliance Ownership


* Serve as the audit and compliance lead for HR applications, supporting SOX, internal audit, and regulatory reviews.
* Review audit findings related to Workday or HR system access, define remediation plans, and partner with implementation teams to ensure timely closure.
* Own documentation of control narratives, evidence requirements, and audit artifacts related to security.

Access Governance \& Oversight


* Define and oversee access lifecycle governance (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) for HR systems, ensuring strong approval, validation, and recertification processes.
* Establish requirements for periodic access reviews and recertifications, including privileged and sensitive access roles.
* Review exception requests and risk acceptances related to Workday access.

CIO, IAM \& HR COE Partnership


* Partner with CIO and HR COE teams to translate security strategy and policy into actionable security configurations.
* Collaborate with IAM teams to ensure Workday is correctly positioned as a source of authority for identity and access decisions.

Role Profile


This role is intended for an individual who:


* Brings deep knowledge of Workday security concepts without needing hands‑on configuration access.
* Operates effectively in governance, risk, and audit‑driven environments.
* Influences outcomes through policy, design authority, and partnership, rather than direct system administration.
Is comfortable serving as the security and audit face of Workday to executives, auditors, and regulators  
* 

  

**Who You Are**

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in data security and privacy management, preferably in Workday or other HR systems/tools.

  

**Preferred Skills:*** Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interact with various departments and present reports to senior management.
* Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in security technologies, strategy \& policies, and automated security access tools.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to conduct thorough risk assessments and develop strategies to mitigate identified risks.
* Collaboration: Ability to work collaboratively with HR, IT, and other departments to ensure integrated security measures.
A ttention to Detail: Keen attention to detail to ensure compliance with security policies and regulatory requirements.  
* 

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.  



  

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid\-friendly culture that supports your well\-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  

  

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  

  

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in\-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting\-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands\-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

At Amazon, our HR Regional Partners are known for their knowledge of HR policies, processes and tools. They act as the front\-line consultants to the business supporting managers in creating a positive employee experience and offering the best HR advice on people matters. They operate independently and are seen as subject matter experts, having deep knowledge in local programs, processes, and policies. They offer strong, credible and compelling advice to business leaders on how to manage their team. They are committed to collaboration with multiple HR Business Partners and HR Centers of Excellence like Benefits, Compensation and Employee Relations who support our employees in across the region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Managers collaborate using different communication channels with the HR Regional Partners (HRP) to support sensitive and often complex employee issues including disciplinary, performance improvement and grievance processes. These channels can include 1:1s, multiple stakeholder meetings, as well as scalable learning formats to educate Managers on relevant people matters. The HRP acts as an influential partner in helping managers with talent and performance management processes, people development, HR policies and implementation of organizational changes. Thanks to their front\-line visibility across businesses, HR Regional Partners are in a position to spot trends, identify emerging needs and address them in collaboration with the appropriate business and HR stakeholders.  

* Performance Management: Work with people managers through performance management cases. Analyze data and trends on Employee Relations and performance management, in order to provide input to the business strategy with the relevant HR Business Partner to prevent the recurrence of known issues.
* Employee Relations: Support relevant ER processes, including disciplinary \& performance improvement programs. Consult managers on people matters that require in depth knowledge of policies, procedures and local legislation, across multiple countries. Manage ER cases, in coordination with the Employee Relations and Legal Teams.
* People Development: Enable the success of new \& experienced managers by leveraging, delivering and improving existing training content and collaborating with the central Talent Development teams to anticipate and address emerging needs. Support managers and employees in identifying training opportunities to further develop functional and managerial skills. Support people managers with career conversations, Development Plans/Career Growth Plans and other development initiatives.
* HR General: Act as stewards of the employee experience and Amazon’s culture. Act as subject matter expert for people tools, processes, programs or projects. Design and deliver Manager Education initiatives to further drive collective education and manager effectiveness. Analyze data and observations across the organization, highlighting trends and recommending/driving solutions, as appropriate.
* Change Management: Manage employees’ programs and support managers and HR leaders to drive improvements in employee experience. Provide support to HR Business Partners and the business on change initiatives

  

A day in the life  

This role is performed through an innovative customer relationship Management tool, which enables this team to be uniquely positioned to identify trending issues and themes through data and inform consequent decisions and initiatives. * Experience working with fast\-moving, high\-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
* Experience working with data and leveraging analytics to make decisions

* Experience prioritizing and handling multiple assignments at any given time while maintaining commitment to deadlines

title: People Technology Delivery Lead
description:
**Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human**  

  

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real\-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.  

  

This is an opportunity to do career\-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

**The Enterprise Technology Team**



The Enterprise Technology team builds and delivers the secure, scalable systems that power how our business runs. Our People Technology Team sits at the heart of this work, overseeing the full Hire\-to\-Retire technical ecosystem—including core applications like Workday, Greenhouse, and Cornerstone—and ensuring these platforms evolve alongside the company's growth. We partner closely with HR, Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, and Business Operations to bring data\-driven, compliant, and innovative solutions to life.


**The Opportunity**



Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as a Delivery Lead and Principal Product Analyst for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on the **Growth \& Talent** pod. In this broad role, you will lead complex, multi\-system initiatives spanning Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, Performance, Learning, and Career Development. You will serve as the crucial conduit between Product Management, Recruiting/Talent Acquisition leadership, Talent Management, and People Operations, driving technical execution against a prioritized backlog to align with Okta's strategic workforce goals.


**What You'll Be Doing**


* **Strategic Leadership:** Technically scope and lead the delivery of multi\-quarter, high\-visibility, executive\-sponsored projects across the Growth \& Talent ecosystem (e.g., Greenhouse ATS integration \& workflows, Cornerstone L\&D platform optimization, and Workday Talent \& Performance solutions).
* **Subject Matter Expertise:** Serve as the functional specialist and delivery lead for the Growth \& Talent pod, specializing in talent acquisition, onboarding, performance management, succession planning, learning management, and career development technology integrations.
* **Core Systems Architecture \& Integration:** Partner with enterprise architects and delivery engineers to drive seamless end\-to\-end integrations across **Greenhouse** (Applicant Tracking System), **Cornerstone** (Learning \& Experience Platform), and **Workday** (Talent, Performance, Skills, and Core HCM).

title: Senior Manager: Learning platform management
description:
**What we are looking for**

Support the management of the technology landscape of State Street Talent development and learning, managing end\-to\-end Learning Management System (LMS) with exposure to integration and curation mechanics. Exposure to learning experience platform (LXP) is definite plus.


Support the execution of the strategic Learning and Talent development strategy and ensures alignment of technology and content to the objectives \& priorities.


The role will interact closely with other Learning functions including Enterprise learning solutions, talent Consultancy, talent management, leadership development, Design \& development and HR Business partners that technology is successfully implemented and is meeting the needs of learning. The role will also interact with State Street HR tech and IT for design, integration, IT support and adoption of new technologies.


The incumbent will report to Head – learning technology and curation. The position is location agnostic to the present State Street office cities.


**Skill required:**

Platform management \| System Migration \| Platform implementation \| Integration management \| Data Analytics \| Learning management System \| Learning Agility \| Solution centricity \| Ability to work under pressure \| Teamwork

  

  

**What you will be responsible for:**

* Execute learning and talent technology strategy. At the direction of the Learning Tech \& Curation Lead work to establish the enterprise\-wide approach to learning and talent technology platform management. This strategy works with learning platforms such as learning management system (LMS) as primary requirement and supporting learning experience platform (LXP). This involved optimal LMS implementation set\-up, migration management, integration with content providers and other platforms in learning, video communication (WebEx/Zoom) and talent platforms.
* Platform management and maintenance. Configuration, Integration, migration, release management and administration experience with learning management systems.
* Support the administration of learning and talent technologies. Support day\-to\-day ongoing operations activities including maintenance, usage, analysis, reporting, L3, integration and administration of the learning technologies.
* Curation mindset. Exposure to optimize learning assets across the organization
* Participate in establishing structure, governance, and context to manage platforms.
* Manage the learner experience with technology. Support the required infrastructure, tools, and integrations to promote a technology\-enabled learning culture.
* Partner with internal stakeholders, curation manager, technology teams and external information to offer customized and vetted selection of the most effective and relevant resources.
* As per required business priorities and strategy changes, willingness to perform other work duties from time to time.

  

**Preferred Qualification and skills**

* Degree level qualification or relevant professional qualification
* Broad experience in the Learning and talent technology space, preferable (not compulsory) in financial institutions.
* High learning agility (ability \& curiosity to learn new skills, new technology and changing dynamics of the work objectives) is a required skill.
* Have worked with LMS (preferably but not limited to CSOD) at the level of configuration, release management, user and access management as solution management perspective (and not just administration management) – Similar experience in LXP (like Degreed, Edcast etc.) is preferable but not compulsory.
* Preferably worked on most of activities like migration management, system analysis, SSO requests, certificate management, API and content collectors integration.
* Excellent data management analysis using MS Excel. Exposure to any other data analysis tool is a plus but not compulsory
* Strong project management skills, ability to execute project plans on a regional and global scale. Tactical planning experience with excellent interpersonal skills
* This role requires a high caliber learning technology professional with broad learning technology platform management experience. A positive can\-do attitude and ability to navigate ambiguity will be key success factors.
* Ability to apply and leverage technology while working across regions and functions are critical elements of the role. Understanding of learning \& talent assets curation and optimization is required plus.
* Authenticity, Empathy and being a very strong team player with collaborative solution\-centric mind\-set is non\-negotiable requirement of this role.
* LMS, PMP and MS office certification (not compulsory)

title: Administrative Assistant III
description:
**We Are Teva**
---------------



We’re Teva, a leading innovative biopharmaceutical company, enabled by a world\-class generics business. Whether it’s innovating in the fields of neuroscience and immunology or delivering high\-quality medicine worldwide, we’re dedicated to addressing patients’ needs now and in the future. Here, you will be part of a high\-performing, inclusive culture that values fresh thinking and collaboration. You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

**The Opportunity**
-------------------



The Executive Assistant will provide high\-quality administrative, coordination, and operational support to the R\&D India leadership team and designated senior global leaders. The role is critical in enabling seamless calendar management, meeting coordination, stakeholder engagement, documentation, travel support, and administrative operations across internal and external stakeholders.

**How You’ll Spend Your Day**
-----------------------------


* Executive Support and Calendar Management.


Manage calendars for senior leaders, including scheduling, prioritization, time\-zone coordination, and meeting logistics.  

Coordinate domestic and international travel, accommodation, itineraries, and expense submissions.  

Prepare leaders for meetings by collating documents, background materials,agendas, and pre\-read materials.  

Meeting Coordination and Follow\-up  

Plan and coordinate leadership meetings, cross\-functional reviews, workshops,town halls, and ad hoc discussions.  

Prepare agendas, record minutes, track action items, and follow up on deadlines.  

Coordinate meeting rooms, virtual links, attendee communication, and logistics.

* R\&D India Administrative Operations


Provide administrative support for the R\&D India unit to ensure smooth day\-to\-day operations.  

Coordinate with Facilities, Security, IT, HR, Finance, Procurement, and other internal functions.Support R\&D portal updates and other internal communication or documentation activities.  

Maintain organized records, files, trackers, and documentation with accuracy and confidentiality.

* External Partner and Stakeholder Support


Support communication and scheduling with candidates, vendors, academic partners, and external stakeholders.  

Provide logistical support for partner meetings, site visits, offsite meetings, and external engagements.  

Draft routine correspondence and manage meeting requests professionally.


R\&D Academy and Internal Programs  

Support R\&D Academy administrative activities, including scheduling, participant coordination, faculty communication, logistics, attendance tracking, and documentation.  

Assist in organizing internal events, team sessions, workshops, and engagement activities.

* Systems and Process Support


Use internal systems for workflows related to purchase orders, contracts, expense reporting, financial tracking, and stakeholder documentation.  

Identify opportunities to improve administrative processes, consistency, and  

efficiency.

**Your Qualification and Experience**
-------------------------------------


* Minimum 5 years of experience supporting senior leaders in a multinational organization, preferably in pharmaceuticals, healthcare, R\&D, business operations,corporate affairs, or external\-facing functions.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and enterprise collaboration tools.
* Excellent calendar management, meeting coordination, documentation, and followup skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with professional presence.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a dynamic environment.
* High level of discretion and ability to handle confidential information.
* Basic understanding of R\&D functions in the pharmaceutical industry preferred.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree preferred, ideally in life sciences, business administration, or a related discipline. Equivalent experience may also be  

considered.
**How We’ll Take Care of You**
------------------------------



At Teva India, care is at the heart of how we work. From your first day, you’ll be welcomed into a people\-first culture built on inclusion, respect, and belonging.


That support extends to you and your loved ones through benefits designed for real life. These include comprehensive medical insurance, OPD coverage, annual health checkups, term life and accident insurance, and confidential emotional wellbeing support through our Optum Employee Assistance Program. You’ll also enjoy healthy meals at work, holistic wellbeing initiatives, and volunteering programs that help you give back to the community.


Your growth matters too. You’ll have opportunities to build future\-ready skills, collaborate on projects with global teams, explore internal career opportunities, and learn through programs such as our AI\-enabled Teva Twist program, R\&D Academy, continuing education, and mentorship.

  

Join our vibrant workplace, where we celebrate milestones, festivals, achievements, and community impact together.

**Teva’s Equal Employment Opportunity Commitment**
--------------------------------------------------


Teva Pharmaceuticals is committed to equal opportunity in employment. It is Teva's global policy that equal employment opportunity be provided without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, disability, pregnancy, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, veteran status, national or ethnic origin or any other legally recognized status entitled to protection under applicable laws. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace for all. If you are contacted for a job opportunity, please advise us of any accommodations needed to support you throughout the recruitment and selection process. All accommodation information provided will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of providing an accessible candidate experience.

title: CTK Svc Associate
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer\-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e\-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  

  

About Amazon Centralized Timekeeping  

  

The vision of the Centralized Timekeeping team is to utilize top talent to streamline time and attendance data entry, reduce payroll defects and provide consistently high service levels. Today, CTK supports and manages time and attendance matters for thousands of Amazon Associates. Requests for edits are submitted via trouble ticketing from operators and HR across the network. The Centralized team manages the ticket queue by executing on the requests on a FIFO basis but will prioritize any payroll impacting ticket if there is a risk of a payroll defect. The efforts of this team support the business by ensuring associate’s time and attendance matters are handled with speed, precision and with customer obsession always in mind.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or Advanced Degree
* Experience performing accurate data entry and analysis
* Experience working in a large team or fast\-paced corporate environment, or experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results
* Experience owning end\-to\-end programs to drive results

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working with Windows, Word, Excel, MyTime (Kronos) and PowerPoint
* Experience in administrative tasks such as data entry, managing data driven report processes or processes
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience with MS Office Suite, CRMs (Salesforce) and other systems
* 6\+ months of human resources experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers.
